info.desc: You're used to your PowerUps, but what will you do when their duration is reduced to only one second?
info.egghint:
Hint 1:
You're going to need a leap second... or even better, 59 leap seconds.

Hint 2:
You need to activate a powerup where you're not supposed to.
info.eggsolution: The Nest Egg is on one of the floating islands holding up the glass window, but how to access it? Falling down on it from the cannon launch doesn't work. Well, consider the hints. Since the level is inside a PhysMod trigger that lowers the duration of powerups to one second, you'll need to find a part of the level outside the trigger. Since triggers are cuboids, it's likely to be where one of your coordinates has an extreme value. It's below the level's floor. In fact, it's not just outside the one-second trigger, it's INside a different trigger. You can access it by standing on the wood beams that connect the orange floor segments. Activating a powerup there will make it last one minute instead of one second. Activate your Gyrocopter there and then collect the first four gems with it, then make it to the top of the tower and fly to the right floating island holding up the glass window all within one minute to claim your Nest Egg. (Without the gems, you will be teleported away.) At least, that's the cool way to do it. You can also just boringly get the gems first and then activate the minute-long Gyrocopter and just fly to the Nest Egg, if you prefer.
info.generalhint:
In this level, the Gyrocopter, Super Bounce, and Shock Absorber PowerUps, each of which usually lasts for five seconds, now only last for one second, due to the level being surrounded by a huge PhysMod trigger. Make sure to perfect your timing of when to activate them.

It's recommended to turn off the "Powerup Timers" setting under Gameplay Options, since they don't update to reflect the reduced durations.
info.name: Minute Second
info.starthelptext: Figuring out how to progress is on you.
info.trivia:
The idea for this level came from me fixing a bug that caused the editor UI of PhysMod triggers to display wrong. I discovered that there are many more properties that PhysMod triggers can change than I thought, including the durations of PowerUps. Originally they were going to be lengthened, but I quickly realized a much more interesting level would come out of shortening them instead.

While bootstrapping the level, I figured out the final cannon launch requires the slope to be at a 30 degree incline to send the marble straight up. When I needed to translate that into a brush that is sheared rather than rotated, I discovered and used arctan(7/12) as a decent approximation to 30 degrees, and it worked! Speaking of that cannon launch, it was originally going to involve a double wall-hit and an ending near the double floating islands, but the cannon trajectory wasn't working out and kept sending the marble backwards, so I redesigned the ending.

Also, if you're reading this, you're beautiful. <3
info.ultimatehint: Go fast, execute your moves well and always know what to do next. Not much more to it.

info.name: Sky Dungeons
info.starthelptext: Can you conquer these challenges, dungeoneer?
info.trivia:
This level has quite a story to tell. It actually began all the way back in 2013, as an LE level for MBP. At the time I didn't know how to make custom interiors, but I did use a state-of-the-art technique to retexture existing interiors, and made many cute levels with that.

Sky Dungeons was initially a response to Tiny Skycastles, a level by Xelna. I was in love with the idea of floating castles in the clouds, so I decided to make my own. Sky Dungeons turned out to be so fun that I followed it up with three sequels, each braver than the last. Alas, these levels have long since been lost to the sands of time, and now exist as only a memory forever imprinted in my builder's heart.

This level is an homage to those lost levels. Its layout is based as closely on the original Sky Dungeons as my memory serves, but completely revamped in the PlatinumQuest style. And it's my first level with a custom interior! I know, I know, it took a while.

Also, if you're reading this, you're beautiful. <3
info.ultimatehint: Collect as many Time Travels as you can. There are more than meets the eye.

remarks:
This is the high-polygon version of Winter Wisps, my take on what is possible with Blender levels. I used geometry nodes to make the curves and procedurally generate the icicles. I took a good deal of inspiration from Marble It Up!'s style, but the gameplay physics are fundamentally Marble Blast. 

This level gets poor to unplayable framerates on low-end systems, particularly those without a discrete GPU and older integrated graphics hardware. As of writing, I am working on figuring out how to use the .dif format to reduce the number of polygons on screen without sacrificing any gameplay, but I don't have much time to work on that atm so I'm putting this level out here now to get it in the hands of players. To get better FPS, disable marble reflections and use a material quality other than "Legacy".

info.generalhint:
Have you ever played Pathways from MBG? The tightropes with moving blockers are just like that! You'll have to anticipate the timings of the blockers very well to pass the tightropes. The same can be said for the trapdoor sections. Also not to mention that some cannons can launch you out of bounds.

Just like many other construction-themed levels, agility is important to pass the obstacles. The moving walls section can be hard, so prepare to fall off a lot of times. Also don't let the scenery confuse you.
info.name: High Finance
info.starthelptext: Be careful, the scenery may confuse you!
info.trivia: As I said in the description, this is my first construction-themed level, and therefore the first level to use the Piece by Piece music. The moving blockers on the tightropes were inspired by Pathways (and also Natural Selection) from Marble Blast Gold.
info.ultimatehint: Unlike my two previous levels, there are Time Travels. Some of them are much harder to catch than the others, but you may have to collect all the TTs to beat this UT, so try to practice each part individually.

info.generalhint: In this level there are also orange slices which are as slippery as mud surfaces. It's best to keep jumping as you travel on the slippery surfaces. There are also oil pipes, be careful navigating them. Remember that hitting fences, oranges or signs can save you from falling off!
info.name: Oiled Oranges
info.starthelptext: Be careful on the slippery oil surfaces!
info.trivia: First of all, this level was inspired by Oil Marginal (as of November 14, 2022 it has over 400 downloads but no loves!), with similar orange and oil textures. I actually played said level in MBPU, and add a challenge (also called Oiled Oranges) to not touch the orange floor texture. The runes found in various places are just like encrypted English scripts but each letter corresponds to each rune, so it's possible to decode them. This level also uses one of Ralph's skyboxes (the first level to do so, and this level in particular uses the sunset skybox in Blazing Margherita). He actually allowed me (and everyone else) to use his skyboxes, so I don't have to worry about copyright.
info.ultimatehint: Just collect all the Time Travels. The final Tango area can be hard though.

info.name: Spectroverse
info.starthelptext: Normal gravity is a thing even in outer space! Makes no sense, isn't it?
info.trivia: The red and blue rotating platforms were inspired by Super Galaxy from Super Mario 3D World. The beacon teleporters, on the other hand, were inspired by Parkour - Animation vs. Minecraft Shorts Episode 22. Oh, and the skybox is the same as the one used in Levitation by Ralph. Not to mention that Spectroverse is not a real word.

Originally, when the time ran out in Gem Madness levels, you would be forced to restart the level. You'd need to touch the end pad to finish the level. This was changed in favor of a less frustrating, more Hunt-like alternative behavior of the clock.

info.desc: In Terraria, magic mirrors are completely useless since you can just quit and reload the game to return home. But in PQ magic mirrors turned out to be pretty useful!
info.egghint: An interior error that will never be fixed.
info.generalhint: When you activate a Magic Mirror, all the yellow platforms will be active for 5 seconds. A timeout warning sound will also play, telling you when the platforms will disappear. Thankfully, there is no Par Time in this level, so don't worry about having to restart the level.
info.name: Opitenata Duka
info.starthelptext: Use the Magic Mirror and see the platforms appear!
info.trivia:
This level's name translates to "Universe of Hidden Platforms". Note that the language used throughout the level is actually my own conlang, a language that is not seen elsewhere in the entire universe. This level is also my first level that is uploaded on the newer version of Marbleland that supports manually flagging dependencies. Also I composed the level's music myself, making this level my first level with a custom music.

Also if you want, try and beat this level without using the Magic Mirror... it is IMPOSSIBLE!
info.ultimatehint: This level can rather be frustrating to speedrun, due to some areas (like the areas with yellow walls) requiring you to waste time. In the section with a lot of platforms in different shapes, try to take the right path, as the left path has harder-to-reach Time Travels.

info.generalhint: Help the player beat your level!
info.name: There & Back Again (Pepperoni Edition)
info.starthelptext: Diagonal movement must be used with caution!
info.trivia: Share some fun trivia about this level!
info.ultimatehint: Help the player beat your level fast!

remarks: Ah, pepperoni and cheese. Together at last.

info.desc: A very simple level to help you get used to rolling around. Follow the track around and roll on to the exit pad to finish the level.
info.easteregghint: Get a running start and hit the edge.
info.generalhint: Get comfortable with the basic controls. Eventually, your path to the finish should be a nice fluid motion.
info.name: MBGR 01: Learning to Roll
info.starthelptext: Use <func:bind moveforward>, <func:bind moveleft>, <func:bind movebackward>, and <func:bind moveright> to roll the marble around!
info.trivia: The level that started it all. Well, really that was my MBG Mashup level that I released in early 2019, but this was the first made for this whole project, to probably no one's surprise.
info.ultimatehint: Use the nearest inside diagonal edge to gain some momentum towards the finish.

info.desc: You must collect all the gems before you can finish.
info.generalhint: Experiment with what order to collect the gems that will take the least amount of time. Starting with the blue one might be a good idea.
info.name: MBGR 02: Collect the Gems
info.starthelptext: Find all five gems!
info.trivia: One of my favorites of the really early levels. I had no expectations of being able to turn the original into something any more exciting, but look what a couple ramps can do for you.
info.ultimatehint: Small edge hit near the finish, and then collect the gems going counter-clockwise.

info.desc: Learn to jump up ramps and across gaps. Roll on to the exit pad to complete the level.
info.generalhint: Gain some momentum so you can get up each ramp without getting caught on any of the flat surfaces in the middle.
info.name: MBGR 03: Jump Training
info.starthelptext: Jump up the ramps and follow the path to the finish!
info.trivia: I'm proud of the attention to detail on this one. The edges are ever-so-slighty raised, the green ramps are all designed exactly like the original, and for a more general point, you get to learn how to jump across gaps!
info.ultimatehint: Time your jump correctly so you jump-slide off the edge rather than a normal edge hit. Don't try going off the sign.

info.desc: Use the Super Jump PowerUp to make big jumps and get to the end of the course.
info.generalhint: Feeling confident? Jump before using a Super Jump to get some extra height.
info.name: MBGR 04: Learn the Super Jump
info.starthelptext: Use the Super Jump PowerUps to get to the finish!
info.trivia: My first time dealing with flat non-90� angles that didn't involve rotating. Yep, it was all just moving vertices around in a way that makes sense.
info.ultimatehint: Get the right angle beforehand so you slide off the wall after using the Super Jump.

info.desc: Get a feel for rolling on platforms in motion.
info.easteregghint: Oops, did you not make it all the way up?
info.generalhint: Jumping early off a rising platform can save a bit if you time it right.
info.name: MBGR 05: Platform Training
info.starthelptext: Ride the moving platforms to reach the finish!
info.trivia: Absolutely earth-shattering. Introducing horizontally-moving platforms and vertically-moving platforms in the same level! Take that, Alex.
info.ultimatehint: The make-or-break trick is pretty easy to spot. You just have to optimize.

info.desc: Learn the fundamentals of the Super Speed PowerUp.
info.generalhint: Don't stall using the Super Speed. PowerUps can be activated immediately if you hold <func:bind mouseFire> before collecting them.
info.name: MBGR 06: Learn the Super Speed
info.starthelptext: Use the Super Speed PowerUp to climb the hill!
info.trivia: A bit tricky to do much with this one, although I thought it would be most important to introduce the Super Speeed in a much easier and less intimidating way.
info.ultimatehint: Use the Super Speed as early as possible. It can be a stretch, but definitely doable.

info.desc: Glide along the gentle slopes and speed to the finish.
info.generalhint: If you want the chance to polish your movement, test out different jump timings to clear the slopes faster.
info.name: MBGR 07: Rolling Hills
info.trivia: One of the things I felt like the beginner levels (from original MBG) were desperately missing was a smooth, fluid, free-flowing level. This one just has a great feel to it, whether you're playing it casually or doing some cool speedrunning tricks.
info.ultimatehint: Basically a straight shot to the finish. You just need to know when to jump and all.

info.desc: Practice what you've learned from the first several levels.
info.generalhint: It's clear where the Super Speed is intended to be used, but that doesn't necessarily mean you have to follow that logic.
info.name: MBGR 08: Exercise
info.starthelptext: Be smart with how you plan out your path to get the best time.
info.trivia: What's very subtly hidden under the mask of this just being a normal level is somewhat of a pathfinding tutorial. My thought process with the Super Speed and the two gem ramps was to encourage skipping the moving platform if the player were imaginative en
info.ultimatehint: Left gem first, and the rest should be obvious.

info.desc: Learn to fly!
info.generalhint: Take a leap of faith.
info.name: MBGR 09: Gyrocopter
info.starthelptext: Use the Gyrocopter PowerUp to fly to the finish!
info.trivia: Awkward rotations in Constructor do not convert well to .dif. That was before the godsend of csx2dif, which almost entirely prompted the update to the beginner levels.
info.ultimatehint: What's the fastest way to the finish? Don't overthink it.

info.desc: Learn how to stop time.
info.generalhint: How long can you keep the clocked stopped?
info.name: MBGR 10: Time Trial
info.starthelptext: Grab the Time Travels on the sides to help you qualify!
info.trivia: I would've loved to make a good Time Travel tutorial level that didn't involve just being a catch level, but that's unfortunately difficult to do while both sticking to the original look and not making the whole thing kinda lengthy. So instead... cactus?
info.ultimatehint: The first Time Travel is the most important one.

info.desc: Learn how to use PowerUps to bounce higher and not at all.
info.easteregghint: Get there before the wall opens up... sort of.
info.generalhint: Practice your control in mid-air. Particularly for the end, see if you can avoid the striped floor with some backspin.
info.name: MBGR 11: Rebound Opposition
info.starthelptext: Bounce to the other side with the Super Bounce PowerUp in front of you!
info.trivia: Always wanted a good excuse to make a tutorial level just based around these two PowerUps. Just feels wrong to include anything else.
info.ultimatehint: You can make it around the striped floor down to the finish. It's hard, but doable.

info.desc: Change gravity to solve this puzzle.
info.generalhint: You don't... *need* the last couple Gravity Modifiers.
info.name: MBGR 12: Gravity Helix
info.starthelptext: Pick up the Gravity Modifiers to roll to the finish!
info.trivia: It was a bit of a challenge to think of any way to make this level more interesting and still keep it helix-esque. Admittedly I was in a bit more of a speedrunner mindset anyway.
info.ultimatehint: Breeze through the first half like the original level, and don't stop jumping. You can skip two of the Gravity Modifiers with a... wall hit?

info.desc: Rush to the other side and grab the gem.
info.generalhint: A super easy way to save time? Skip the Super Bounce.
info.name: MBGR 13: Zipline
info.starthelptext: The finish is next to you! But you need something first...
info.trivia: My nod to There and Back again. Actually a fun level this time.
info.ultimatehint: There are a couple of ways to do this, in the sense that both PowerUps can do a lot for you. My biggest tip is to hit the wall where the gem is instead of going around.

info.desc: Test your skills with the Super Jump.
info.generalhint: Can you get the highest gem only using one Super Jump?
info.name: MBGR 14: Leapfrog
info.starthelptext: Look where you're trying to land before you use a PowerUp!
info.trivia: Originally much easier in the beginner set until I felt that this was maybe a bit too complex for then. This I probably played the most in testing, just because of a gloriously filthy wall-slide I found to help me get the highest gem.
info.ultimatehint: Each of the high gems should be collected immediately after getting a Time Travel.

info.desc: Learn about the different surfaces.
info.generalhint: Take advantage of the fact that you can get the two gems in the low friction areas in a straight line and not have to worry too much about your control.
info.name: MBGR 15: Marble Materials Lab
info.starthelptext: Be careful on the slippery floors!
info.trivia: Learn the Super Jump was made before this which means I had played around with building parts of levels at 45° angles without any use of rotation. That slight turn in the grass part is 22.5°, or a fourth of 90°. The giveaway is that the finish looks small compared to the four tiles it sits on, but it's actually the tiles themselves because... well, math. Shoutouts to the useless white ramps!
info.ultimatehint: Time the obvious jump correctly and make your path as direct to the finish as you can.

info.desc: Avoid the bumpers!
info.generalhint: Bumpers can be both helpful and harmful with how hard they bump you away.
info.name: MBGR 16: Bumper Training
info.starthelptext: Roll to the finish!
info.trivia: Finally a bumper tutorial with the triangle variant!
info.ultimatehint: Skip the entire upper area with the large triangle bumper or an edge hit.

info.desc: Beware of the wind from the fans.
info.generalhint: As you practice this level, it'll become easier to get a feel for the fans and eventually breeze through this level pretty smoothly.
info.name: MBGR 17: Breezeway
info.starthelptext: Don't get blown off-course!
info.trivia: One of my worries was the last part being inconsistent, but I'm thrilled to no end that it took minimal effort to get that right. You can roll across, start with a jump, whatever. As long as you're going straight, I think it'll work every time.
info.ultimatehint: You have methods of getting enough momentum and height to skip across. Fortunately, that's the hard part.

info.desc: Ride the moving platforms and aim for the gaps in the walls.
info.easteregghint: Find a way to stay on the second platform to the end of its path, or at least be there when it's stopped.
info.generalhint: A very common level style where the best strategy is to simply look forward all the time. Be quick at the end!
info.name: MBGR 18: Hole in the Wall
info.starthelptext: You can call back the moving platforms, but that loses you a lot of time.
info.trivia: So the game show has the walls moving instead of the platform, oh well. It's almost an impossible task to come up with an interesting name for a level that's just a pretty generic moving platform challenge.
info.ultimatehint: The traplaunch is necessary, but you can either bounce all the way to the finish or get creative with the last wall and the Super Jump.

info.desc: Don't fall to these new hazards.
info.generalhint: Another case where you can tear through this level without really stopping. Try clearing the last section with only two jumps.
info.name: MBGR 19: Triple Threat
info.starthelptext: Quickly roll over the trapdoors or you'll fall through!
info.trivia: One of the things that sticks out to me most about the level design here is how the tornado isn't actually functioning as a hazard. Maybe "Triple Threat" isn't quite accurate after all, but at least that means more chances to design levels with the helpful side of tornadoes in mind.
info.ultimatehint: The most recognizeable method is to get a great mine hit. If that's not the mood, try the slick edge hit after the tornado.

info.desc: Test your skills on this upwards spiral.
info.generalhint: This is all very straightfoward. Just make sure not to get caught up in the moving blocks.
info.name: MBGR 20: Gyre
info.trivia: Marble Blast Ultra's "Moving Up" was the original inspiration, hence the somewhat-similar starting layout. Those curves were rough to convert before csx2dif existed.
info.ultimatehint: Find a better place to use the Super Jump than right at the beginning.

info.desc: Test your footing by avoiding the gaps in the floor.
info.generalhint: Given that going in a straight line is usually fastest, build enough confidence to start jumping over the gaps.
info.name: MBGR 21: Pitfalls
info.starthelptext: Watch out for the holes!
info.trivia: One of my favorites of the beginners! I always thought the original Pitfalls was such a beautifully simple level that had so many ideas practically knocking on the front door, and even though I only held myself at moving platforms on this one, just the general style of this has always been near and dear to me.
info.ultimatehint: Huge skip on this one. Don't let your nerves get the best of you after you land it.

info.desc: Watch out for the moving blocks that will knock you off the course!
info.generalhint: It helps that the blocks pause as they move from side to side. The ones that are closer together can absolutely be skipped through in multiples.
info.name: MBGR 22: Basher Bridge
info.trivia: Definitely pulls inspiration from Marble It Up! with the way that the blocks pause before moving again. I also got a slight trigonometry lesson from Vanilagy since I wanted to learn exactly how much I should rotate the blocks that move across the ramps.
info.ultimatehint: Keeping the clock stopped after getting the Time Travel is the hardest part because of those last four blocks. This one generally isn't too bad though.

info.desc: Follow the path and fly to the goal.
info.generalhint: That Super Jump is very powerful.
info.name: MBGR 23: Winding Road
info.starthelptext: Follow the winding road, using the PowerUps to cross the gaps!
info.trivia: Opted to go with Marble Blast Ultra's variant of the start of the level. I wanted to include a Super Bounce and a Shock Absorber to have every PowerUp, but that would've been pretty lengthy.
info.ultimatehint: Played the original? You know what to do. It is a bit of a reach though.

info.desc: Scale the outside of this building.
info.generalhint: Since you can only see what's in front of you after you turn the corner, remembering what comes next ahead of time can help a lot.
info.name: MBGR 24: Tower of Ease
info.trivia: I couldn't help myself and not make a generic tower level. The style is too iconic that I practically did it more for the irony than anything else.
info.ultimatehint: Take full advantage of the one PowerUp you're given.

info.desc: Overcome all the beginner challenges to get the gems!
info.easteregghint: Tucked away pretty remotely. You'll need a Gyrocopter and probably a wall hit or two.
info.generalhint: Your first real test on pathfinding. Collecting gems that are closer together will obviously be faster than travelling across the map multiple times.
info.name: MBGR 25: Grand Finale
info.starthelptext: Find all the gems!
info.trivia: This was one of my favorites to build simply because of how well-designed and fun the original is. My main goal for the redesign to have significantly less symmetry, which provided some interesting means of making this level more exciting.
info.ultimatehint: The PowerUps are your best friends, since not every gem needs to be grabbed in their intended ways.

info.name: Undertow
info.starthelptext: Check the surface of the water to see which way the current is flowing.
info.trivia:
The idea for this level came to me in a dream. Not really, but it did just randomly pop into my head at some point, including the sun values, general structure, and the specific green tile texture to use. I also imagined using thin pillars with sloped trim around them a la Marble City, Cube Isle, Megas, or Marbleland, as well as gray fade platform bridges similar to the solid ones lining the outside, but ultimately scrapped both of those ideas.

The area where you jump up off of ramps to collect the gems was inspired by Spacecurve by Wilchz, the spinning fans on ice was stolen from a previous level of mine called Current Events, and the Torque logo statue in the park was also stolen (directly, literally copied and pasted plus a little extra rotation) from another one of my levels, GBA Sky Garden. Three other islands were also inspired by Path Finding Folly, Sprawl, and Spires. Do you think you know which?

Special thanks to Mazik for playtesting the singleplayer version and giving lots of feedback, Creep and Jean for playtesting and feedback on the multiplayer version, A-Game for some extra help debugging the randomized undertow direction, and Keppy for helping me get custom countdown icons working in a way that works with Marbleland.
info.ultimatehint:
Wishing to fight the flow? Touching down on the water friction with some good spin and popping back up over the surface with a jump + Bubble combo to repeat will get you places effectively. But it's still slower than just rolling on land!

Aside from the blue chevrons in the banks, the park's signs and center structure's graffiti also signify the direction of the water's flow.

info.trivia: This is my second level, and it was just as much pain to get working as my first! If you want to see my process, check out my YouTube videos on PlatinumQuest level building at https://youtube.com/@Jack5Official.
info.ultimatehint: Make sure you have the speed to jump over walls or scale ramps in your way when fighting gravity, and don't forget about the powerups.

remarks:
I've already been through the hell that is making Marble Blast levels, but for some reason, after 2 years I've come back. And this time, I'm not just a masochist, I'm a sadist too, because I want all of you to experience the pain of playing my levels, just as I suffer while making them.

Amazeing! It Moves By Itself! is a level wherein you are the marble inside a marble maze, which is actively being moved around by some unseen force. Your goal is to collect 20 gems as fast as possible while fighting off the frequent changes in gravity. Check the level hints for tips on how to improve your time!

A breakdown of how I built this level is featured in my video "The Making Of a Marble Blast Marble Maze: AGONY INCARNATE": https://youtu.be/Tyq5Ew3imL8

info.desc: Explore this nearly-heated gold mine. This place is really deep underground, but it's still not the deepest place underground.
info.egghint: Notice the hatch right before the escalator? There is a spinning gold bar below it. You'll have to find some secrets (what could be below the elevators?) if you want to get it, and once you get it... something will happen in a different level.
info.generalhint:
Due to the limitations of the Torque Game Engine, if you touch any lava you have a chance of not being able to see your marble. Always remember to press the respawn button whenever you're about to touch a lava texture. If your marble does become invisible, quit and restart the level.

Trouble beating the minecart section? You can actually get to the third floor and jump down so that you bounce on one of the platforms by the rails, and land on the platform with the lever. It's tricky, but doable. Also, you can skip some of the lava lightsabers using the raised platforms.
info.name: Nearhic Nimefract
info.starthelptext: You're an important marble. Falling into lava is the last thing you'd want to do here.
info.trivia:
Opitenata Duka, my 22nd level, was uploaded on June 17, 2023, and this level was uploaded over half a year after. That's a long time! Deciding the name of the level took a long time, since there are not so many words starting with the 14th letter of the alphabet.

This level is also my first level that was playtested by a community member, specifically Berserk. I posted the level file to the level-building channel of the MB Discord server several days before release.
info.ultimatehint:
Once you activate a mechanism (via a switch or a computer), it will not reset unless you restart the level. This means you can activate something and immediately respawn on the last-touched checkpoint to shave off a lot of seconds.

This hint and the Awesome Hint took a long time to decide, which resulted in a somewhat long delay of releasing the level after the playtest version was posted.

info.name: It would be beneficial for you to acquire the skill of rolling a marble. This entails gaining the knowledge and proficiency to successfully navigate a small, round object across a surface with precision and control. By mastering this ability, you can improve your hand-eye coordination, dexterity and fine motor skills. It is a valuable ability that can be utilized in various activities and games, such as playing marbles or simply entertaining yourself with a fun pastime. Therefore, it is highly recommended that you dedicate time and effort in learning how to roll a marble effectively.
info.desc: The level in question has been thoughtfully crafted to provide an uncomplicated and user-friendly experience, with the primary objective being to help you acclimate to the practice of rolling. Your task is to navigate the designated course, maintaining a steady trajectory throughout, and ultimately land on the designated exit pad in order to successfully complete the level.

info.generalhint: The qualifying speed is 50. Use the powerups in combos to generate enough speed to finish. Remember that there are powerups at the top!
info.name: Imminent
info.trivia: The original name for this level was "Immediate".
info.ultimatehint: Practice your powerup combos for maximum efficiency. There are some cool tricks you can do...

info.awesomehint: The two Time Travels on the middle plank will help a lot. Remember that there's a gem there as well!
info.desc: Plenty to collect, and plenty to skip...
info.generalhint: The Super Jump is highly useful, as it allows you to collect the higher gems. It respawns instantly after pickup.
info.name: Scattered
info.trivia:
This level's Gem Quota was originally 10/20, then 11/22, and now 12/24.

My 100% Quota best is 00:20.213.

Originally, I planned to add ice shards in the ice section, but later decided against that, as it made playing the level more irritating.
info.ultimatehint: Cut off isolated gems in your route and make a centralized and non-branching route.

info.awesomehint: Good jumps, and a sprinkle of luck...
info.desc: Endless gems...
info.generalhint: The Time Travel in the middle takes 15 seconds to respawn. Plan carefully!
info.name: Collector
info.trivia:
The original idea was to create an all red gem Hunt level, with no Time Travels, and not much geometry, to reduce reliance on luck and spawn loops. It was... very boring, and still quite luck-reliant.

As such, I remade the interior, added a bunch more gems, and added a Time Travel.
info.ultimatehint: Focus on the gems more than the Time Travel, as time only allows it to respawn three times maximum.

info.desc:
Learn the very basic key mechanics of Marble Blast! 

Rozi's Mini Mod: Beginner Level 1
info.easteregghint: Cross the gaps and turn around.
info.generalhint: Collecting the highest gem last means you can take the shortcut and jump straight to the finish.
info.name: Basics
info.starthelptext: Press <func:bind moveforward> to roll your marble forward!
info.trivia: The third iteration of the opening level to Rozi's Mini Mod.
info.ultimatehint: If you consider the aforementioned gem order, what's the fastest way to get to the first gem?

info.desc:
Go around the loop learning the different PowerUps in the game! 

Rozi's Mini Mod: Beginner Level 2
info.easteregghint: It's pretty close to you already; you just need to get some help.
info.generalhint: As long as you avoid falling off and you choose the right Time Travel, you should be in perfectly good hands.
info.name: PowerUp Loop
info.starthelptext: Use <func:bind mouseFire> to activate a PowerUp!
info.trivia: Yeah, so going backwards works. I didn't exactly plan on that while building this level, but once Eguy showed me it was easily possible, I had no intention of killing that. I love the path.
info.ultimatehint: Going backwards would do the job. The last gem requires a neat trick.

info.desc:
Not all in Marble Blast is in your favor. 

Rozi's Mini Mod: Beginner Level 3
info.easteregghint: The egg is easy to spot, but not to grab. You need some help!
info.generalhint: Most of the hazards in the middle are arranged in a way where you can align yourself and roll right through, rather than having to weave around.
info.name: Hazard Swivel
info.starthelptext: Caution stripes indicate a dangerous area.
info.trivia: One of the few levels from Rozi's Mini Mod to get a pretty hefty makeover. The original didn't have as much of a centerpiece like this version does, and the extent of decoration were some pretty sad-looking brown tunnels. Most of what's similar ends after
info.ultimatehint: That second set of bumpers is your best friend.

info.desc:
Learn the basics of frictions! 

Rozi's Mini Mod: Beginner Level 4
info.egghint: Catch a glimpse of the fourth friction.
info.generalhint: You don't need the Super Speed to jump that gap, so maybe find a better use.
info.name: Frictional Spiral
info.starthelptext: Pay close attention to the surfaces you're rolling on!
info.trivia: This was definitely a case where I was coming up with speedrunning ideas as the level was being built, hence why the Super Speed even exists and why there isn't a gem in the space section.
info.ultimatehint: Skip most of the second mud section with an edge hit and avoid the space altogether.

info.desc:
Watch your footing as the floor moves under you. 

Rozi's Mini Mod: Beginner Level 5
info.easteregghint: Just a little peek around the corner...
info.generalhint: Look ahead at the positions of the swaying platform and the block as you come up to them so you can breeze right on by.
info.name: Moving Platforms
info.starthelptext: Platforms can move! The first one in front of you takes you up.
info.trivia: The latter half of the original level consisted of weaving around walls on a moving platform, and Ordeal-esque blocks that bumped you upward. Too hard!
info.ultimatehint: Yeah, you can hit that traplaunch. You just need to be brave and sit more off the edge than normal.

info.desc:
Roll on walls. 

Rozi's Mini Mod: Beginner Level 6
info.easteregghint: You pass right under it! There's plenty of ways to grab it - find what's most fun for you!
info.generalhint: Have some bravery falling into the Gravity Modifiers; it's sort of a swinging motion that becomes pretty fun once you get a feel for it.
info.name: Gravity Maze
info.starthelptext: Be sure to not miss the Gravity Modifiers by falling in between then.
info.trivia: One of the few that wasn't a solo effort - BPXRockU donated a smaller version for release, that I rebuilt from scratch and expanded into what you see today.
info.ultimatehint: The big shortcut is obvious. The smaller one is also easy to find. Otherwise, get a quick turnaround for the first gem.

info.desc:
Watch your step on the low traction surfaces. 

Rozi's Mini Mod: Beginner Level 7
info.easteregghint: Aim high.
info.generalhint: Continuous jumping on low friction surfaces helps your control immensely.
info.name: Wooden Bridges
info.trivia: Maybe my favorite level-making error I've made in the original version, where the InBounds trigger was placed just too high that going in the pits in the floor sent you out of bounds.
info.ultimatehint: Take advantage of the nuances, such as the sloped edges or even wallhitting off the sides, especially to get height.

info.desc:
Test your motor skills on this simple course. 

Rozi's Mini Mod: Beginner Level 8
info.easteregghint: Get higher up and trust the lack of fall damage.
info.generalhint: Cut corners with the sloped edging.
info.name: Slope Run
info.trivia: Does anyone care about unnecessary detail of the building process? Those four small slopes are split into nine segments each. 9 does not comfortably divide into any early multiple of 8.
info.ultimatehint: The biggest time save is a huge jump up to the finish. See above comment about sloped edging.

info.desc:
Traverse the layers. 

Rozi's Mini Mod: Beginner Level 9
info.easteregghint: No trouble spotting the egg. Finding how to get to it is a little more tricky though. It's not far!
info.generalhint: The moving platform is a great vertical resource, but you can easily do without it.
info.name: Super
info.trivia: Contrary to some belief, Marble Blast Super has no connection with this. 15-year-old Nockess just didn't have the largest vocabulary.
info.ultimatehint: The first gem should be obvious, and the ideal last gem should have a quick way to the finish close by. Now to get creative with the second gem...

info.desc:
How quick are you to react at high speeds? 

Rozi's Mini Mod: Beginner Level 10
info.easteregghint: It's awfully high up. You'll want the second Super Speed for the second loop (don't confuse this).
info.generalhint: The Super Speeds are pretty nice, especially when you find the right jumping pattern to get you to the finish in under 11 seconds!
info.name: Upward Momentum
info.starthelptext: There are Super Speeds in front of both loops and the last jump for your help. Don't let that be an excuse to go slowly though!
info.trivia: The only level I've ever made with malformed brushes; breaking everything up into triangles would've just been too much. The flags also make up for just under half the total brushes!
info.ultimatehint: Speaking of finding the right jumping patterns, you can completely skip the blue and orange sections.

info.trivia: This level has around 165 brushes, which is 10 less than the theoretical breaking point of my Constructor build. At 175 brushes, it starts to do some weird stuff,. Weirdest part, it only happens for me.

info.starthelptext: Find the gems but don't fall off!
info.oldultimatehint: It's the same route as you're used to, just with a few minor adjustments.
info.name: Spicy B25 Battlecube
info.oldeasteregghint: Look behind the faces of the cube.
info.desc:
Welcome to the Battlecube Series!
This series is dedicated to Alex Swanson.
Have fun!

info.starthelptext: Use the Super Speed if you want to bump your head even harder!
info.oldultimatehint: A little bit of diagonal and jumping has never hurt anyone.
info.name: Spicy B11 Bump Your Head!
info.oldeasteregghint: Go outside the tunnel.
info.desc: You'll feel very dizzy indeed at the end of this.

info.starthelptext:
Shoot up the stalk to get the diamonds!
Hint: Press Jump before using the Super Jump to get more height.
info.oldultimatehint: The way you start and the timing of the Super Jumps will be critical.
info.name: Spicy B09 Busy Bee...
info.oldeasteregghint: The higher you go, the closer you'll reach it.
info.desc: Collect the gems around the flower!

info.starthelptext: Learn how to use diagonal movement!
info.oldultimatehint: Diagonal movement, as learnt, makes you go faster. So go fast to finish this level. However, at some point, you do need to slow down so you end up hitting a lower time. Find out where!
info.name: Spicy B21 Diagonal Training
info.oldeasteregghint: There is a Gyrocopter on one of the pillars that you can use to reach the very end of the level.
info.desc: Learn how to use diagonal movement to make your marble go faster.

info.starthelptext: Find all the gems, then roll for the finish pad!
info.oldultimatehint: There're two ways to collect the gems and both ways beat the UT. Which way will you go?
info.name: Spicy B03 Gem Round-Up
info.desc: If a level has gems, you must pick them all up before you can finish.

info.starthelptext:
The Gyrocopter can be used in many ways.
Learn the basics!
info.oldultimatehint: Get from the first gem to the second by using one Gyrocopter item only.
info.name: Spicy B07 Flight of the Marble
info.oldeasteregghint: Fly to the very top.
info.desc: Use the Gyrocopter item to fly!

info.starthelptext: Find the shortcut to finish with the best time!
info.oldultimatehint: Try jumping to the goal.
info.name: Spicy B06 Gravity Knot
info.desc: By picking up the Gravity Modifiers, you can roll on the walls!

info.starthelptext: Avoid the nukes unless you want to get blown to bits!
info.oldultimatehint: Test the three nukes at the start. Hit them correctly!
info.name: Spicy B17 Ground Zero
info.oldeasteregghint: Use one of the nukes to reach the tunnel roof.
info.desc: Watch out for nukes!

info.starthelptext: Do a lap around the loop, but don't let the hazards throw you off!
info.oldultimatehint: Jump to skip the tightropes and use the tornado to launch yourself to the finish.
info.name: Spicy B23 Hazard Loop
info.oldeasteregghint: Find a hidden Super Jump in one of the trapdoors. Use it to reach the center platform where a Gyrocopter is. Then, use that to find the egg.
info.desc: Learn about hazards as you collect the gems!

info.starthelptext: Press <func:bind jump> to Jump!
info.oldultimatehint: Blame Lonestar for the pathway from start to finish.
info.name: Spicy B02 Jump Tutorial
info.oldeasteregghint: Do a sign hit to reach one of the arches where a Super Speed is. Use it to reach the other arch.
info.desc: Jump up the stairs and to the finish!

info.starthelptext: Don't fall off and "keep on rollin!"
info.oldultimatehint: No need to jump on the fan.
info.name: Spicy B24 Keep on Rollin'
info.desc: Pass the hazards ahead!

info.starthelptext: Use the Super Speeds to help you finish faster.
info.oldultimatehint: There's more than one way to beat this Ultimate Time. Find a path you'll be happy with!
info.name: Spicy B15 King of the Marble
info.oldeasteregghint: This is a tricky one. Make sure you have a Super Speed with you. Once you perform an edge hit at the center, use that Super Speed to propel yourself upwards where the egg is floating.
info.desc: Collect the gems while racing against the clock.

info.starthelptext: Step off the pad to start bouncing!
info.oldultimatehint: It's all about speed and timing.
info.name: Spicy B10 Learn the Bouncy Floor!
info.desc: Use several examples that will teach you about the bouncy floor in this game.

info.starthelptext: Hit the edge in order to pass the challenges ahead!
info.oldultimatehint: Be careful with the speeds to which you reach each edge hit.
info.name: Spicy B22 Learn the Edge Hit
info.oldeasteregghint: Gain lots of momentum to edge hit up to one of the arches.
info.desc: Use several examples that will teach you how to edge hit.

info.starthelptext: Learn the friction forces that appear in this game!
info.oldultimatehint: Stolen off MBU.
info.name: Spicy B04 Learn the Friction!
info.oldeasteregghint: The random force technically makes it's first appearance in this level. It is hidden in one of the inner corners.
info.desc: Use several examples that will teach you about the friction forces in this game.

info.starthelptext: Jump on the islands if you feel you cannot battle the force!
info.oldultimatehint: You don't have to go through the random force. Well, almost.
info.name: Spicy B14 Learn the Random Force
info.oldeasteregghint: Use the sloped edging on one of the ice platforms to reach the roof. Then, look in one of the corners.
info.desc: You never know what might happen when you hit the Random Force!

info.starthelptext:
Collect the Time Travels and finish before the Par Time!
An alarm will sound when your time is about to run out.
info.oldultimatehint: The route to take is obvious: take as many TTs as possible. But for a very very low time, go for an edge hit!
info.name: Spicy B13 Learn the Time Travel
info.oldeasteregghint: There is a platform on the other side of where the finish is. A ride is at the very end of it. It'll take you to the bottom of the level. You'll find the egg there.
info.desc: Learn the different times and bonuses you can have on the Time Travel!

info.starthelptext: Wall-hits are used when you must reach a platform that is too high to jump to.
info.oldultimatehint: Instead of slowing down after the first wall hit, you can just hit the wall normally instead of jumping. This will get you to the first gem much faster.
info.name: Spicy B12 Learn the Wall-Hit
info.oldeasteregghint: Once you're near the end, you'll find out where it is.
info.desc: Learn how to do wall-hits to make yourself go higher.

info.starthelptext: Press the <func:bind moveforward> key to roll the marble forward!
info.oldultimatehint: Go diagonal and JUMP!
info.name: Spicy B01 Let's Roll!
info.oldeasteregghint: Find a hidden Gyrocopter and use it to grab the egg.
info.desc: Learn how to play Marble Blast Platinum!

info.starthelptext: Magnets can be both a help and a hindrance to the marble.
info.oldultimatehint: Go in speed and time your jumps to pass flawlessly to the end. Otherwise, you can simply edge hit from start to finish, but that's hard.
info.name: Spicy B16 Magnet Training
info.desc: Learn about magnets!

info.starthelptext: Have fun!
info.oldultimatehint: Blame Moshe for his pathway for an easy UT beater.
info.name: Spicy B19 Mini Mountain
info.desc: Pass the obstacles and climb up the small mountain!

info.oldultimatehint: Start from the gems to the left, go clockwise and in the next section, do the same after you got the center gem.
info.name: Spicy B20 Ramps
info.oldeasteregghint: Find a secret area where the finish is.
info.desc: Collect all the gems on top of each ramp.

info.starthelptext: Control your bounce as you hit the floor!
info.oldultimatehint: Try not to use any powerups along your way... except for the last one.
info.name: Spicy B18 Recoil Training
info.oldeasteregghint: Behind the start pad is a floating Super Bounce and a Super Jump. Use both the reach the pillar with a slanted roof.
info.desc: Practice your skills on bouncing!

info.starthelptext: The teleport is used to transport you to different locations in a level.
info.oldultimatehint: Take a leap of faith!
info.name: Spicy B08 Teleport Training
info.oldeasteregghint: If you explore the level, it should be fairly easy to find.
info.desc: Learn to use the teleport!

info.starthelptext: Remember to slow down after landing from using a powerup.
info.oldultimatehint: Go diagonally and aim with the Super Speed carefully straight to the goal. Very easy, actually.
info.name: Spicy B05 Training Towers
info.oldeasteregghint: Super Speed under the launch ramp.
info.desc: Learn how to use moving platforms, Super Jumps and Super Speeds!

info.starthelptext: Climb on the bar and take a slide for the win!
info.oldultimatehint: You'll need a lot of diagonal usage here...
info.oldeasteregghint: This is a tough one. It is under the first lump, but what makes it tough is how you get it. You have to use a Super Speed while falling down and spinning backwards, which will take several tries.
info.name: Spicy I22 Astroflight
info.desc: Just a small level to test your skills!

info.starthelptext: Can you make it past the hazards?
info.desc: Pass the hazards and make your way to the finish.
info.oldultimatehint: Use the tornado to cross the gap!
info.name: Spicy I09 Avoiding Hazards

info.starthelptext: Don't slip off the level.
info.desc: A quick level to test your skills. Beware of the ice!
info.oldultimatehint: Find a good path for the start and you're set.
info.name: Spicy I08 Basic Agility Course

info.oldeasteregghint: It is on the other side of the ceiling. A gravity change and a Super Jump should do it.
info.starthelptext: Six faces to find the diamonds on!
info.oldultimatehint: Too many paths for this level, but I prefer taking the ceiling last.
info.name: Spicy I35 Battlecube Revisited
info.desc: Even though this level is easy are you capable of finding the best path?

info.starthelptext: Evade the bumps, making sure you don't fall off!
info.oldultimatehint: You can cross two gaps with ease if you use diagonal.
info.name: Spicy I25 Bumpy Highway
info.desc: Evade the bumps, making sure you don't fall off!
A level meant for shortcuts, but you can beat it the long way too.
info.oldeasteregghint: Try changing gravity and falling all the way down to the other side of where the start pad is.
info.oldultimatehint: You did train in loop exits, right?
info.name: Spicy I20 Byzantine Helix

info.starthelptext: Pick your shortcut!
info.desc: This level has so many shortcuts, it's not even funny!
info.oldultimatehint: Aim for the Super Jump and use it to the goal!
info.name: Spicy I21 Convoluted Helix

info.desc: Use the Tornadoes to your advantage!
info.name: Spicy I03 Tornado Launch
info.oldultimatehint: Patience is a virtue.
info.starthelptext: Use the tornadoes to your advantage!

info.oldultimatehint: Go to the blue island first, then pink. Wait for the Super Jump to respawn to exit the Havoc Zone faster with the help of the tornadoes straight into the teleporters.
info.name: Spicy I34 Daedal Helix
info.desc: This level requires quick thinking and a fast reaction time, as well as general skills.

info.starthelptext: Choose your path... or your shortcut.
info.oldeasteregghint: Behind the finish sign.
info.oldultimatehint: Stolen from MBU.
info.name: Spicy I33 Divergence
info.desc: All roads lead to the finish!
Roll around the inside of the rings to collect the gems.
info.oldeasteregghint: Below the gem under the rings. Change gravity or use a Super Speed.
info.oldultimatehint: Either start with the loops, or go down, it is your choice.
info.name: Spicy I15 Double LoopLoop

info.starthelptext: Inspired by Level Seven.
info.desc: Roll quickly down the slopes before time runs out!
info.oldeasteregghint: Find a Gyrocopter behind the green arrow sign, which you can get to by wall hitting the starting arch. Use that gyrocopter to fly to one of the towers on the left, where the egg is located.
info.oldultimatehint: Time your start and collect enough TTs.
info.name: Spicy I14 Downhill Racing

info.starthelptext: Climb to the top using rugs and carpets!
info.oldeasteregghint: When you're about more than halfway up, you should find it.
info.oldultimatehint: I like to use the last Super Speed from the very top, but that's just because it's fun.
info.name: Spicy I30 Dragged Up!
info.desc: Use the Super Speeds to help you get up to the end!

info.starthelptext: Go up the path and use the powerups to get to the next floor.
info.oldeasteregghint: Jump and double Super Jump high enough to reach it, but be careful, as you'll go out of bounds before getting it.
info.oldultimatehint: Use the Super Jump to get to the next floor from the sides.
info.name: Spicy I24 Floor Climb
info.desc: Up the floors we go!

info.starthelptext: Don't forget your towel!
info.oldeasteregghint: There is a hole that can be accessed via the roof, which you can reach by using a Super Speed. Fall through it.
info.oldultimatehint: Go to the left first, then bumpers, ice, the structure and finish with the fans/nuke bit.
info.name: Spicy I31 Gym
info.desc: Use your marble skills to find all the gems!

info.starthelptext: Use the Super Speeds ahead to your advantage!
info.desc: Loops have never been so much fun!
info.oldeasteregghint: You can loop exit and control your spin in the air to reach the top of the first loop.
info.oldultimatehint: You can loop exit straight to the finish!
info.name: Spicy I17 Loop Exits

info.starthelptext: Jump for the gems!
info.oldultimatehint: The gems in the small tubes in the centre of the map can be collected by simply rolling outside the tubes.
info.name: Spicy I28 Marble Agility Course
info.desc: Can you take it all in stride?

info.oldeasteregghint: Wall hit off the icy stairs to reach it.
info.oldultimatehint: You can escape the club!
info.desc: Pass the ice-covered challenges!
info.name: Spicy I07 Marble Mini Golf: Icichole
info.starthelptext: Aim carefully into the tunnel!

info.desc: Go through the castle's maze to find the gems!
info.name: Spicy I04 Medieval Maze
info.oldeasteregghint: This is a rather fun one to get. There is a secret passageway you can enter by using the first Super Jump you see, from the right side of the castle. It should lead you towards the egg at the end.
info.oldultimatehint: Go right first, then head towards the Super Jump.

info.name: Spicy I06 Marble Mini Golf
info.starthelptext: Beat the Par, the Birdie and the Eagle!
info.desc: Roll along this small, garden-style course.
info.oldeasteregghint: Gain as much speed as you can so you can hit the flower behind the start and gain enough height to reach to top of the arch.
info.oldultimatehint: Slow down as you jump onto the flower, you'll find it much easier.

info.desc: Ascend up the path and head for the finish!
info.name: Spicy I02 Mountaintop Retreat
info.oldeasteregghint: In the section where the Super Speed is, you can use it to reach a hole carved on one of the scenery pillars.
info.oldultimatehint: Stolen from MBU.
info.starthelptext: Ascend up the path and head for the finish!
You only get one chance at things here, don't lose it.
info.oldultimatehint: Use the Super Bounce powerup to hit the Gyrocopter and then hit the gem and skillshot the goal!
info.name: Spicy I26 Perplexingness
info.desc: Can you find the pathway for the Platinum Time on this perplexing level?

info.starthelptext: Don't forget to collect the gems!
info.desc: Practice your powerup skills!
info.oldeasteregghint: The apex of the level.
info.oldultimatehint: Use each powerup smartly.
info.name: Spicy I16 Powerup Practice

info.starthelptext: Use your brain! If you have one, that is.
info.oldeasteregghint: Use your brain to reach the top of the first arch. If you have one, that is.
info.oldultimatehint: Use your brain to find the shortcut! If you have one, that is.
info.name: Spicy I29 Puzzle Ordeal
info.desc: Can you figure out how to get past the obstacles?
Roll around the maze of ramps, collecting the gems!
info.name: Spicy I05 Ramp Madness
info.oldultimatehint: It's a simple route, but do the outside gems last.

info.desc: Lead the marble up the tricky trail but don't let the clock beat you!
info.oldeasteregghint: There is a Gravity Modifier behind where the Shock Absorber is. Once you've used it to change gravity, simply fall down to the egg when you find it.
info.oldultimatehint: There's a small shortcut to bypass some of the level.
info.name: Spicy I12 Roll Like the Wind!

info.starthelptext: Use your best marbling skills to pass the trials ahead!
info.oldeasteregghint: Behind the wall where the Shock Absorber is. Can you figure out how to get it?
info.oldultimatehint: From the Super Jump, get to the trapdoors' gem and use the Shock Absorber to get to the random floor's gem.
info.name: Spicy I32 Skill Zone
info.desc: Serious concentration and effort are needed here.

info.starthelptext: Make your way past the trials ahead to finish!
info.desc: Control your spin so you can collect the gems ahead!
info.oldeasteregghint: Wall hit to the roof!
info.oldultimatehint: Skip from one side to another!
info.name: Spicy I19 Spin Practice

info.desc: A short race for you and your friends.
info.oldeasteregghint: Aim carefully into the hole to the left of the ending arch.
info.oldultimatehint: Cut your path short and go fast on the tightropes.
info.name: Spicy I13 Sprint

info.starthelptext: Taking a stroll is not always easy...
info.desc: Move and jump carefully up and around the platforms, making sure you control your spin!
info.oldeasteregghint: Jump off a sloped edging to reach it.
info.oldultimatehint: You can still cross the gap!
info.name: Spicy I11 Take a Stroll...

info.starthelptext: Be careful on trim...
info.desc: Be careful around the tornado...
info.oldeasteregghint: There is a Gyrocopter below the tornado. Use it to fling yourself up to the egg.
info.oldultimatehint: Did you know I have sub-10? That's because I used the tornado and the trim.
info.name: Spicy I10 Technoropes

info.desc: Can you make it to the finish in time?
info.name: Spicy I27 Timely Ascent
info.oldeasteregghint: If you observe the level from the start, you should see it if you look closely enough.
info.oldultimatehint: In MBU they wall hit, in MBP we edge hit.

info.desc: Welcome to the Intermediate Levels!
info.name: Spicy I01 Triple Decker
info.oldeasteregghint: Need for the Super Speed.
info.oldultimatehint: No need for the Super Speed.
info.starthelptext: Go around the 3 story building, collecting the gems!
Collect the gems in the building by bouncing off the walls!
info.desc: Master your wall-hitting skills!
info.oldultimatehint: I found it faster to make a sign hit, but its harder.
info.name: Spicy I18 Wall Master

info.oldultimatehint: There should be some points where you don't stop jumping.
info.name: Spicy I23 Winding Steps
info.desc: Perfect your jumping skills.

info.name: Spicy A16 Beach Party
info.desc: Zoom through this fun, Gravity Modfier-packed course!
info.oldultimatehint: You sure you need the first Gravity Modifier?
info.oldeasteregghint: You'll definitely need the first Gravity Modifier. Fall off the ideal path once you do so.

info.starthelptext: Activate the powerups at the right time in order to pass the ordeals ahead!
info.name: Spicy A27 Combo Course
info.desc: Put your powerup skills to the ultimate test!
info.oldultimatehint: Think well on how to use each powerup. Not all challenges need the two powerups available.
info.oldeasteregghint: Fly to once of the holes behind where the fourth challenge is.

info.oldultimatehint: Cut through bits of the level
info.oldeasteregghint: Under one of the twisted platforms.
info.starthelptext: Can you do it?
info.name: Spicy A14 Crash Course
info.desc: A small yet challenging course to test your skills.

info.oldultimatehint: Trap your way to the finish, the intended way.
info.oldeasteregghint: You'll need to do a traplaunch for this one.
info.starthelptext: When times get tough, don't lose hope!
info.name: Spicy A30 Despair
info.desc: Stay on the platform to pass the level!

info.oldultimatehint: There's more than one path, and you have more than enough time bonus to use.
info.oldeasteregghint: Look behind one of the walls. The wall in question stands out.
info.starthelptext: Explore around for the hidden gems!
info.name: Spicy A02 Gem Seeking Fun!
info.desc: Go around the platforms searching for the gems! Look out for hidden Time Travels! And don't forget, you have two minutes!

info.oldultimatehint: Jumping does help!
info.oldeasteregghint: Near the end of the level. Approach it with caution.
info.starthelptext: Jumping as you roll onto a slope might help you climb them.
info.name: Spicy A10 Fighting Slopes
info.desc: Can you make it up the slopes without falling off the bottom?

info.starthelptext: Collect the gems, but don't rush!
info.name: Spicy A23 Frictional Ascent
info.desc: Ascend to the top while traversing the hazardous friction and collecting the gems, but don't rush!
info.oldultimatehint: Amazingly there is a shortcut, just find a method to save that Jump Boost.
info.oldeasteregghint: Get plenty of height off the icy half pipe to reach a secret area.

info.starthelptext: Roll and jump around but don't slip off the level!
info.name: Spicy A35 Frictional Battlecube
info.desc: Master the friction surfaces!
info.oldultimatehint: The old version of the level was way harder. After the ice melts, it becomes water.
info.oldeasteregghint: Behind the sandy side. A Super Speed can help, but it might be tough.

info.oldultimatehint: Go diagonally and make a special start to skillshot this UT.
info.oldeasteregghint: Overshoot the finish!
info.starthelptext: One-Way Skillshot!
info.name: Spicy A03 Gap Aimer
info.desc: Use the Gyrocopter to help you aim to the goal!

info.name: Spicy A24 Ice Cold Pass
info.desc: Pass through the swerving path of the cold pass.
info.oldultimatehint: From start to finish in a single hit
info.oldeasteregghint: You'll need to walk on a few tighropes, and fall off.

info.oldultimatehint: Hit the edge and come back the way you came. Don't travel on the other side of the big gap after the loop!
info.oldeasteregghint: The very top, much like Slope Madness.
info.starthelptext:
Pay attention to messages.
They will help you to complete the level correctly.
info.name: Spicy A13 Lightning Ice
info.desc: An amazingly speedy and short challenge. Pay attention to the help messages - they are very important!

info.name: Spicy A25 Michael's Adventure: MBP!
info.desc: Michael's Adventure strikes again!
info.oldultimatehint: Disregard the marble's safety on tightropes.
info.oldeasteregghint: One of the corners of the level behind the start. A nuke hit should do it.

info.desc: An unforgettable moving platform challenge.
info.name: Spicy A31 Morph
info.starthelptext: Follow the arrows and watch this level morph before your eyes.
info.oldultimatehint: The only thing here to rely on is speed.
info.oldeasteregghint: This is a fun one. When you reach the finish, you'll activate the entrance to inside the castle, where the egg resides.

info.oldultimatehint: Find a route to skip parts of the level fast. Use the gyrocopter more than once if needed.
info.oldeasteregghint: The only scenery pillar in the level is where the egg is. Fly to its dark side.
info.starthelptext: A small course to test your skills.
info.name: Spicy A15 NeonTech
info.desc: Progress along the uber-styled, technical floors!

info.oldultimatehint: Try and get gems in one jump. Control your spin, if that helps.
info.oldeasteregghint: On top of the finish sign. Nuke hit your way up there.
info.starthelptext:
Danger!
You're now entering a Nuke Field Zone!
info.name: Spicy A08 Nuke Field
info.desc: Get the gems and Time Travels but don't get blown away!

info.oldultimatehint: Memorize the locations of what you need.
info.oldeasteregghint: The smiley face has a nose.
info.starthelptext: Find the gems without putting in any flags!
info.name: Spicy A05 Nukesweeper
info.desc:
Play the next generation game of Minesweeper, called Nukesweeper!
Play the demo today!

info.oldultimatehint: Grab the nearest Gravity Modifier first, then instead of going the full route go down and hit another Gravity Modifier to go back to normal gravity with the 2nd gem at hand.
info.oldeasteregghint: Get a Super Jump, then go back to the starting section and use it to reach behind the top of the level.
info.starthelptext: Search for the gems quickly; you don't have much time!
info.name: Spicy A04 Orange-Fold Maze
info.desc: More of a course combined with a small strategy involved.

info.oldultimatehint: Ask a Pathway Finder to help you here.
info.oldeasteregghint: Touch the end pad to grab a secret Super Jump. Use it to reach the top of the level.
info.starthelptext: Be hasty!
info.name: Spicy A20 Par Pit
info.desc: Get all the gems before time runs out!

info.oldultimatehint: Go fast, there're barely any shortcuts here
info.oldeasteregghint: Stolen from Upward Spiral MBU.
info.starthelptext: Be careful!
info.name: Spicy A18 Perilous Road
info.desc: Follow the road to the top.

info.oldultimatehint: I recall Matan and Lonestar doing an awesome path on YouTube.
info.oldeasteregghint: Once you change gravity, go off the beaten path.
info.starthelptext: Find the Gyrocopter PowerUp and use it to your advantage!
info.name: Spicy A01 Pink-Fold Maze
info.desc: Collect the gems and the time modifiers to score the best possible time!

info.oldultimatehint: Wait for it to respawn.
info.oldeasteregghint: Save the Super Jump for the fourth section.
info.starthelptext: Get the gem at each stop in under 15 seconds, or the platform will leave you behind!!
info.name: Spicy A09 Platform Race
info.desc: You need good speed and agility for this one.

info.oldultimatehint: Get on the platform and off the platform ASAP. If you manage the traplaunch and the route for sub-1 minute... wow!
info.oldeasteregghint: Find a way to reach the top of the tower.
info.starthelptext: Do you feel the pressure?
info.name: Spicy A21 Platform Race 2
info.desc: Get the gem at each stop in 10 seconds or the platform shall leave you behind!

info.oldultimatehint: The key is to jump...
info.oldeasteregghint: Fall off one of the holes.
info.starthelptext: Just hang on, marble!
info.name: Spicy A22 Quaked Path
info.desc: Follow the path moving back and forth! The key is not to jump...

info.starthelptext: Can you handle the randomness?
info.name: Spicy A34 Random Mayhem
info.desc: Navigate your marble to its destinations while fighting off the hardest force of them all!
info.oldultimatehint: Amazingly, at some points if you go at a certain direction, it will just help you go straightforwards in the direction you wanted. Use the sloped edges to stop your marble on each island. Ah, you did practice your spin, right?
info.oldeasteregghint: Use a Super Speed to reach the top of the finish sign.

info.oldultimatehint: You can hit with the gyrocopter and slant and then hit the next gem and the ring instead of going normally. Then, grab all the gems on the last part and bounce twice to the finish!
info.starthelptext: Be sure you have the right speed and height before going through the rings!
info.name: Spicy A19 Ring Stunts
info.desc: Jump or fly through the rings to get the gems.

info.starthelptext: Use the sloped edging to your advantage!
info.name: Spicy A33 Rolling to Eternity
info.desc: Collect all ten gems by going through a variety of obstacles!
info.oldultimatehint: Use the checkpoint and the super jump to your advantage.
info.oldeasteregghint: Stolen from Daedalus MBU.

info.oldultimatehint: You can cut off some of the path.
info.oldeasteregghint: You should see it. Do an edge hit.
info.starthelptext: Take care when crossing the ice.
info.name: Spicy A11 Slippery Steps
info.desc: Steps can be slippery.

info.oldultimatehint: Go all the way to the other side first and then get to the last gem where the teleporter is.
info.oldeasteregghint: Hidden in the left section of the level.
info.name: Spicy A17 Slip Up
info.desc: You'll have to control your spin in these varying friction challenges!

info.oldultimatehint: Get a good path and go fast!
info.oldeasteregghint: The very top. Use a Super Jump and a Gyrocopter.
info.starthelptext: Slopes have never been so much fun!
info.name: Spicy A12 Slope Madness
info.desc: Use the available powerups and your best marbling skills to get all the gems.

info.starthelptext: Keep in mind that you will need to conquer some of the techniques ahead.
info.name: Spicy A29 Strategy Climb
info.desc: Move your way to climb up the challenging path ahead!
info.oldultimatehint: Jump early for the TT.
info.oldeasteregghint: Behind the section where you change gravity.

info.oldultimatehint: You can find more Time Travels than it might seem.
info.oldeasteregghint: Stolen from Upward Spiral MBU.
info.name: Spicy A07 Swivel
info.desc: Swivel around the holes, loops and bumpers!

info.starthelptext: Beware; there are traps and obstacles galore in this castle!
info.name: Spicy A32 Thief
info.desc: Invade the castle and steal all the gems within before time runs out!
info.oldultimatehint: Ever hit a nuke with a gyrocopter? Try it, you get tons of height.
info.oldeasteregghint: Nuke hit to one of the scenery castles.

info.starthelptext: Collect the gems and get to the finish without falling.
info.name: Spicy A26 Treacherous Path
info.desc: Can you make it past the treacherous hazards?
info.oldultimatehint: Start the path normally, skip to the end and then do the level backwards.
info.oldeasteregghint: Fall off a trapdoor.

info.oldultimatehint: Hit the TT first, go back [after passing the goal] and edge hit to the first gem and do the level in order. Of course you can cut off some bits.
info.oldeasteregghint: Behind the finish sign.
info.starthelptext: Jump past the obstacles ahead!
info.name: Spicy A06 Treachery
info.desc: Jump past the platform obstacles to survive!

info.starthelptext: Make sure to maintain your balance on the treacherous branches!
info.name: Spicy A28 Ultimate Tree
info.desc: Explore this beautiful tree and collect the gems on the branches.
info.oldultimatehint: Decide on a route which will collect everything. Most of the TTs will be useful.
info.oldeasteregghint: Between the two elevators inside the trunk. Maybe a Gyrocopter should do it.

info.desc: Fly around this bizarre structure! Accuracy, precision and strength are needed.
info.name: Spicy E18 Arch Acropolis
info.oldultimatehint: Read the description carefully.
info.oldeasteregghint: Fly to behind one of the scenery towers. The egg is located under the roof though.

info.oldultimatehint: The hardest there is. Find a path that you can memorize and once you run out of gems to remember, just try and memorize which floors you should go to next. Ah, the gyrocopters will come in handy. Be patient, and practice a lot, this isn't going to be an easy ride. Last tip: Make sure you have a lot of spare time, this will take a while to beat.
info.oldeasteregghint: It is inside the finish sign. If you don't know exactly where to Super Jump, it can be difficult to get.
info.name: Spicy E25 Battlecube Finale
info.starthelptext: Race against the clock on all twelve faces of this mad level!
info.desc: Can you make your way through the final battle?

info.name: Spicy E09 Bouncing Fun
info.oldultimatehint: Complete each part fast and get all the TTs.
info.oldeasteregghint: Precisely roll behind the slanted bouncy floor in Part 3.
info.desc: Pass each bouncy challenge to finish!
If one may fall or go to the sides, but not too far, the teleporter shall put them back to the start.
info.name: Spicy E15 Cardcaddy's Gem Collection
info.oldultimatehint: Ends up there's an easy path and that the platforms go in order. Find that order.
info.oldeasteregghint: Use a Super Jump to reach the top of one of the swaying scenery pillars. But be careful, you'll need perfect timing.
info.starthelptext: Up and down all night long!
Can you maintain your balance long enough to make it to the end?
info.desc: Good balancing skills are the key to success here!
info.name: Spicy E20 Catwalks
info.oldultimatehint: Ever hit a nuke and landed on a tightrope? Fear not for the marble's safety. For a faster time, think what you can do with the gravity modifiers.
info.oldeasteregghint: Save a Super Jump for when you reach the first checkpoint. Use it to grab the egg from under the tightrope.

info.name: Spicy E06 Dizzying Heights
info.starthelptext: Don't look down!
info.oldultimatehint: Honestly, as if the answer couldn't be more obvious! Or perhaps the ice slipped it away?
info.desc: Climb to the top of the tower while avoiding the hazards.
You're used to jumping, but what will you do when you just can't risk it?
info.name: Spicy E16 Don't Jump!
info.starthelptext: Only now will you realise how important the jumping ability was, won't you?
info.oldultimatehint: Take risks and use the checkpoint to your advantage, if you can.
info.oldeasteregghint: You should be able to see it right as when you start of the level. Use a fan to lift you there after you jump.

info.name: Spicy E07 Gyrocopter Monster Course
info.starthelptext: Welcome to the Gyrocopter Monster Course!
info.oldultimatehint: Collect all the TTs, both large and small.
info.desc: Shape up your Gyrocopter skills!

info.oldultimatehint: It's another one of Phil's levels, of course it has shortcuts.
info.oldeasteregghint: After the small bouncy floor section, you should see it in one of the corners of the scenery pillars.
info.name: Spicy E23 Mastering the Marble
info.starthelptext: Can you master the challenges awaiting you?
info.desc: You made it so far, but how good really are you with your marble skills? Master the marble, beat the course.

info.oldultimatehint: Go right to the half pipe first, skillshot a TT on a tightrope and then get to the 2nd gem first.
info.oldeasteregghint: Of all the scenery towers in the level, the blue one stands out.
info.desc: The biggest adventure of all!
info.name: Spicy E03 Michael's Final Adventure!

info.oldultimatehint: Memorize your path, big time.
info.oldeasteregghint: This is one of the more memorable ones. Stay inside one of the boxes with a gem inside of it. If you wait long enough, the platform will take you down to a secret room. Figure out which of the boxes in it has the egg.
info.desc: Test your memory in this fast-paced game. Find all the gems without putting in any flags!
info.name: Spicy E05 Nukesweeper Revisited
info.starthelptext: If you go into a wrong square, it could spell 'Game Over'.

info.oldultimatehint: Amazingly, there is a path.
info.oldeasteregghint: This one is really fun. Change gravity at the end of the left section of the level. You should then see a Gyrocopter and a Super Jump on the half pipe of the scenery arch. Touching it will activate a white moving platform. Use both powerups to reach the section where it was activated. Touching that section will activate the next white platform, rinse and repeat. Follow them until you eventually reach the egg.
info.name: Spicy E13 Platform Mayhem
info.starthelptext: That is so not your everyday level!
info.desc: Whoever built this level is probably a two year old baby!

info.name: Spicy E08 Recoil Ultra Course
info.starthelptext:
Welcome to the Recoil Ultra Course!
Get the gems on each challenge. Get each Time Travel to get the best time!
info.oldultimatehint: Go fast and collect all TTs. Try not to fail anything.
info.oldeasteregghint: Behind one of the walls near the end of the level. Change gravity to reach it.
info.desc: Put all your recoiling skills to the ultimate test!

info.name: Spicy E12 Sand Storm
info.oldultimatehint: Speed is all you need. The rest will be aligned. Also, it's Phil's level, expect a shortcut, even if not obvious.
info.oldeasteregghint: Use a secret Gyrocopter to reach a lonely platform where the egg is.
info.desc: Pass through the blowing, pushing and bending fort!

info.starthelptext: Don't look down!
info.desc: Slow and steady does the trick.
info.name: Spicy E19 Slowropes
info.oldultimatehint: Ever went very fast on tightropes? Try it here.
I hit a 6:08 while missing the 8 and 15 secs TTs and having a double respawn. UT should be fine for you then. Also, there are small shortcuts along your route... A Phil's level or what? :)
info.oldeasteregghint: You can actually find the moon in this level. All you have to do to reach it is find a teleporter behind a slanted bouncy platform. Disappointingly, it isn't made of cheese.
info.name: Spicy E24 Space Station
info.starthelptext: Good luck, but remember you can't get any help.
info.desc: Enter the Space Station, explore the planets. Do you have the energy for this mission?

info.name: Spicy E10 Speed Attack
info.oldultimatehint: Like the rest, it's to collect as many TTs as possible and to go fast.
info.oldeasteregghint: It is actually vital that you don't outrun the teleporter at the end of the level. You will be sent to a lonely ice platform where the egg is.
info.desc: Train in the way of the Super Speed!

info.oldultimatehint: Did you find the hidden gyrocopter?
info.oldeasteregghint: Fall off the platform where the finish pad is to reach it.
info.desc: Make your way by using skills and techniques! You don't have much time, so try to qualify!
info.name: Spicy E01 Stamina

info.starthelptext: Gigantic, isn't it?
info.desc:
You've never seen such a skyscraper before, have you?
Climb to the top, if you dare.
info.name: Spicy E22 The Tale of the Tall Skyscraper
info.oldultimatehint: Try and not fall off. Also, keep in mind there are 3 easy shortcuts.
info.oldeasteregghint: Navigate the first floor of the skyscraper itself, and hug the wall until you trigger a secret door. Follow it.

info.name: Spicy E11 The Time Travel Race
info.starthelptext: The race is on!
info.oldultimatehint: I'm not left handed, but this level likes the left.
info.oldeasteregghint: This one always fascinated me (the one writing this, Blasted). There is a Gyrocopter and a Super Jump behind the end pad. Use both to fly up to a tower with another Gyrocopter and Super Jump on top of it. Use those to fly to yet another tower with both powerups. Keep going until you reach a lonely platform with the egg on it.
info.desc: Collect the Time Travels throughout this race and finish before the Par Time.

info.oldultimatehint: Don't slip off the level!
info.oldeasteregghint: The roof of the finish house.
info.name: Spicy E21 The Ultimate Friction Challenge!
info.starthelptext: Welcome to the Ultimate Friction Challenge!
info.desc: The iciest and slipperiest level you will ever play!

info.starthelptext: Keep moving so that you don't fall through the trapdoors!
info.desc: Get to the end without falling through!
info.name: Spicy E17 Trapdoor Mania
info.oldultimatehint: Edge hit but don't slow down!
Start by clearing the left side first and then the right side from top to bottom.
info.oldeasteregghint: Under one of the tightslopes.
info.desc: Only elite marblers dare venture the treacherous complexities!
info.name: Spicy E04 Trigonometry

info.oldultimatehint: Just one maze to solve.
info.oldeasteregghint: Change gravity and go outside the pipes. The egg should be in sight.
info.desc: Not one but two mazes to solve!
info.name: Spicy E02 Tunnel Vision
info.starthelptext: Pipes just got ugly...

info.desc:
Wall-hit to the top in less than 100 seconds!
Don't get too frustrated!
info.name: Spicy E14 Uphill Racing
info.oldultimatehint: Thank god I didn't use Pascal's sub-20 pathway when setting this Ultimate Time.
info.oldeasteregghint: Probably my favortie egg of the bunch. Much like Downhill Racing, there's a Gyrocopter behind the arrow sign. Use it to reach the top of the tower behind where the start pad is. You'll need plenty of momentum before the wall hit, though.
info.starthelptext: Level Nineteen Inspired Level Seven.

info.desc: Not everything is as it seems!
info.name: Spicy D01 Bent Reality
info.starthelptext: Don't trust your senses! Take your chances!
