info.desc: You're in a castle wars game! Get to the other team's castle, steal their diamond and bring it back to your tower before they do the same!
info.name: Spicy D02 Castle Wars!
info.starthelptext: This game of castle wars begins now!

info.desc: How fast can you find the gems?
info.name: Spicy D03 Cubed Maze

info.desc: Dedicated to Technostick who simply cannot stand long levels.
info.name: Spicy D04 Diamond Travel
info.starthelptext: Take your time!

info.name: Spicy D05 Dual Perspectives
info.desc: Make sure you explore both sides of this crazy level!
info.starthelptext: Can you find the best path?

info.desc: Reach the summit of this building to grab the gem then head for the finish!
info.name: Spicy D06 Excalibur
info.starthelptext: Pretty easy if you know how to do it!

info.name: Spicy D07 Frictional Climb
info.desc: Climb to the top of the tower as you practice your friction skills!
info.starthelptext: Watch your step!

info.name: Spicy D08 Getting Squeezed
info.starthelptext: Use the Anti-Recoils to stop yourself from bouncing off platforms.
info.desc: Squeeze yourself between moving platforms to give yourself a big boost!
Warning:  EXCESSIVE EXPOSURE CAN CAUSE DISORIENTATION AND HEADACHES.
info.name: Spicy D09 Gravity Shaker

info.starthelptext: Collect all the diamonds that are floating in mid air.
info.desc: Level Dedicated to Cardcaddy
info.name: Spicy D10 Half Pipe Dive
Spicy D11 Happy Birthday!
info.desc: After the candles will be blown up, collect the presents hidden in them!
info.starthelptext: A special birthday level for a special Marble Blast friend!

info.desc: Roll through the building, avoiding the hazardous gaps in the floor!
info.name: Spicy D12 Hazardous House

info.starthelptext: Don't give up! It will take many tries!
info.desc: Climb like a cat up the treacherous tower!
info.name: Spicy D13 Hug the Wall

info.desc: Travel along this beautiful, vast icy world down the crystal slopes.
info.name: Spicy D14 Ice Diamond
info.starthelptext: Speed to the finish but don't break the ice!

info.desc: Aim carefully!
info.name: Spicy D15 Jump Boost Aim

info.desc: Learn to use the anti-recoil to make falling easier.
info.name: Spicy D16 Learning the Anti-Recoil
info.starthelptext: Use the Anti-Recoil PowerUp to avoid bouncing off when you land!

info.desc: Learn the basics of rolling around! Follow the path around and touch the finish pad to finish the level.
info.name: Spicy D17 Learning the Basics
info.starthelptext: Press <func:bind moveforward> to roll the marble forward!

info.desc: The easiest way to pass such courses is to not to touch any controls!
info.name: Spicy D25 Rube Goldberg Course
info.starthelptext: If, by chance, the marble stops completely, press a bit forwards and let the fun continue!

info.desc: Your Marble has been magnetized. Stay away from magnets or be pulled out of bounds. It's your choice.
info.name: Spicy D18 Magnetic Adventure
info.starthelptext: Move Forward and Back to break free.
Follow the signs!
info.name: Spicy D19 Master the Jump Boost
info.desc: Timing and spin control are essential.
A mini marble golf level which wasn't good for me...
info.name: Spicy D20 Mini Marble Golf - DC
info.starthelptext: Get to the finish as fast as you can!

info.desc: Mess with gravity at your peril!
info.starthelptext: Grab the diamonds, but watch out for the Gravity Defyers!
info.name: Spicy D21 Newton Knew Best...

info.desc: Climb to the top of the 2-D world!
info.name: Spicy D22 Platformer

info.desc: Don't you love going to the pool?
info.name: Spicy D23 Pool

info.desc: Blast beyond heaven!
info.name: Spicy D24 Ramp Launch
info.starthelptext: Roll forward, and hold down the powerup button!

info.desc: Travel in and out the sanctuary to collect all the gems!
info.name: Spicy D26 Sanctuary
info.starthelptext: May God help you along your route!

info.desc: Master your stair climbing skills!
info.name: Spicy D27 Stairmaster
info.starthelptext: Whoever invented stairs sure wasn't a marble.

info.desc: Collect the diamonds in this box as fast as you can!
info.name: Spicy D28 Trampoline Box

info.desc: Pass the hazards ahead!
info.name: Spicy D29 Widow's Peak
info.starthelptext: Don't fall off and keep on rollin'!
Find the gems but don't fall off!
info.oldultimatehint: It's the same route as you're used to, just with a few minor adjustments.
info.name: Chaos B25 Battlecube
info.oldeasteregghint: Look behind the faces of the cube.
info.desc:
Welcome to the Battlecube Series!
This series is dedicated to Alex Swanson.
Have fun!

info.starthelptext: Use the Super Speed if you want to bump your head even harder!
info.oldultimatehint: A little bit of diagonal and jumping has never hurt anyone.
info.name: Chaos B11 Bump Your Head!
info.oldeasteregghint: Go outside the tunnel.
info.desc: You'll feel very dizzy indeed at the end of this.

info.starthelptext:
Shoot up the stalk to get the diamonds!
Hint: Press Jump before using the Super Jump to get more height.
info.oldultimatehint: The way you start and the timing of the Super Jumps will be critical.
info.name: Chaos B09 Busy Bee...
info.oldeasteregghint: The higher you go, the closer you'll reach it.
info.desc: Collect the gems around the flower!

info.starthelptext: Learn how to use diagonal movement!
info.oldultimatehint: Diagonal movement, as learnt, makes you go faster. So go fast to finish this level. However, at some point, you do need to slow down so you end up hitting a lower time. Find out where!
info.name: Chaos B21 Diagonal Training
info.oldeasteregghint: There is a Gyrocopter on one of the pillars that you can use to reach the very end of the level.
info.desc: Learn how to use diagonal movement to make your marble go faster.

info.starthelptext: Find all the gems, then roll for the finish pad!
info.oldultimatehint: There're two ways to collect the gems and both ways beat the UT. Which way will you go?
info.name: Chaos B03 Gem Round-Up
info.desc: If a level has gems, you must pick them all up before you can finish.

info.starthelptext:
The Gyrocopter can be used in many ways.
Learn the basics!
info.oldultimatehint: Get from the first gem to the second by using one Gyrocopter item only.
info.name: Chaos B07 Flight of the Marble
info.oldeasteregghint: Fly to the very top.
info.desc: Use the Gyrocopter item to fly!

info.starthelptext: Find the shortcut to finish with the best time!
info.oldultimatehint: Try jumping to the goal.
info.name: Chaos B06 Gravity Knot
info.desc: By picking up the Gravity Modifiers, you can roll on the walls!

info.starthelptext: Avoid the nukes unless you want to get blown to bits!
info.oldultimatehint: Test the three nukes at the start. Hit them correctly!
info.name: Chaos B17 Ground Zero
info.oldeasteregghint: Use one of the nukes to reach the tunnel roof.
info.desc: Watch out for nukes!

info.starthelptext: Do a lap around the loop, but don't let the hazards throw you off!
info.oldultimatehint: Jump to skip the tightropes and use the tornado to launch yourself to the finish.
info.name: Chaos B23 Hazard Loop
info.oldeasteregghint: Find a hidden Super Jump in one of the trapdoors. Use it to reach the center platform where a Gyrocopter is. Then, use that to find the egg.
info.desc: Learn about hazards as you collect the gems!

info.starthelptext: Press <func:bind jump> to Jump!
info.oldultimatehint: Blame Lonestar for the pathway from start to finish.
info.name: Chaos B02 Jump Tutorial
info.oldeasteregghint: Do a sign hit to reach one of the arches where a Super Speed is. Use it to reach the other arch.
info.desc: Jump up the stairs and to the finish!

info.starthelptext: Don't fall off and "keep on rollin!"
info.oldultimatehint: No need to jump on the fan.
info.name: Chaos B24 Keep on Rollin'
info.desc: Pass the hazards ahead!

info.starthelptext: Use the Super Speeds to help you finish faster.
info.oldultimatehint: There's more than one way to beat this Ultimate Time. Find a path you'll be happy with!
info.name: Chaos B15 King of the Marble
info.oldeasteregghint: This is a tricky one. Make sure you have a Super Speed with you. Once you perform an edge hit at the center, use that Super Speed to propel yourself upwards where the egg is floating.
info.desc: Collect the gems while racing against the clock.

info.starthelptext: Step off the pad to start bouncing!
info.oldultimatehint: It's all about speed and timing.
info.name: Chaos B10 Learn the Bouncy Floor!
info.desc: Use several examples that will teach you about the bouncy floor in this game.

info.starthelptext: Hit the edge in order to pass the challenges ahead!
info.oldultimatehint: Be careful with the speeds to which you reach each edge hit.
info.name: Chaos B22 Learn the Edge Hit
info.oldeasteregghint: Gain lots of momentum to edge hit up to one of the arches.
info.desc: Use several examples that will teach you how to edge hit.

info.starthelptext: Learn the friction forces that appear in this game!
info.oldultimatehint: Stolen off MBU.
info.name: Chaos B04 Learn the Friction!
info.oldeasteregghint: The random force technically makes it's first appearance in this level. It is hidden in one of the inner corners.
info.desc: Use several examples that will teach you about the friction forces in this game.

info.starthelptext: Jump on the islands if you feel you cannot battle the force!
info.oldultimatehint: You don't have to go through the random force. Well, almost.
info.name: Chaos B14 Learn the Random Force
info.oldeasteregghint: Use the sloped edging on one of the ice platforms to reach the roof. Then, look in one of the corners.
info.desc: You never know what might happen when you hit the Random Force!

info.starthelptext:
Collect the Time Travels and finish before the Par Time!
An alarm will sound when your time is about to run out.
info.oldultimatehint: The route to take is obvious: take as many TTs as possible. But for a very very low time, go for an edge hit!
info.name: Chaos B13 Learn the Time Travel
info.oldeasteregghint: There is a platform on the other side of where the finish is. A ride is at the very end of it. It'll take you to the bottom of the level. You'll find the egg there.
info.desc: Learn the different times and bonuses you can have on the Time Travel!

info.starthelptext: Wall-hits are used when you must reach a platform that is too high to jump to.
info.oldultimatehint: Instead of slowing down after the first wall hit, you can just hit the wall normally instead of jumping. This will get you to the first gem much faster.
info.name: Chaos B12 Learn the Wall-Hit
info.oldeasteregghint: Once you're near the end, you'll find out where it is.
info.desc: Learn how to do wall-hits to make yourself go higher.

info.starthelptext: Press the <func:bind moveforward> key to roll the marble forward!
info.oldultimatehint: Go diagonal and JUMP!
info.name: Chaos B01 Let's Roll!
info.oldeasteregghint: Find a hidden Gyrocopter and use it to grab the egg.
info.desc: Learn how to play Marble Blast Platinum!

info.starthelptext: Magnets can be both a help and a hindrance to the marble.
info.oldultimatehint: Go in speed and time your jumps to pass flawlessly to the end. Otherwise, you can simply edge hit from start to finish, but that's hard.
info.name: Chaos B16 Magnet Training
info.desc: Learn about magnets!

info.starthelptext: Have fun!
info.oldultimatehint: Blame Moshe for his pathway for an easy UT beater.
info.name: Chaos B19 Mini Mountain
info.desc: Pass the obstacles and climb up the small mountain!

info.oldultimatehint: Start from the gems to the left, go clockwise and in the next section, do the same after you got the center gem.
info.name: Chaos B20 Ramps
info.oldeasteregghint: Find a secret area where the finish is.
info.desc: Collect all the gems on top of each ramp.

info.starthelptext: Control your bounce as you hit the floor!
info.oldultimatehint: Try not to use any powerups along your way... except for the last one.
info.name: Chaos B18 Recoil Training
info.oldeasteregghint: Behind the start pad is a floating Super Bounce and a Super Jump. Use both the reach the pillar with a slanted roof.
info.desc: Practice your skills on bouncing!

info.starthelptext: The teleport is used to transport you to different locations in a level.
info.oldultimatehint: Take a leap of faith!
info.name: Chaos B08 Teleport Training
info.oldeasteregghint: If you explore the level, it should be fairly easy to find.
info.desc: Learn to use the teleport!

info.starthelptext: Remember to slow down after landing from using a powerup.
info.oldultimatehint: Go diagonally and aim with the Super Speed carefully straight to the goal. Very easy, actually.
info.name: Chaos B05 Training Towers
info.oldeasteregghint: Super Speed under the launch ramp.
info.desc: Learn how to use moving platforms, Super Jumps and Super Speeds!

info.starthelptext: Climb on the bar and take a slide for the win!
info.oldultimatehint: You'll need a lot of diagonal usage here...
info.oldeasteregghint: This is a tough one. It is under the first lump, but what makes it tough is how you get it. You have to use a Super Speed while falling down and spinning backwards, which will take several tries.
info.name: Chaos I22 Astroflight
info.desc: Just a small level to test your skills!

info.starthelptext: Can you make it past the hazards?
info.desc: Pass the hazards and make your way to the finish.
info.oldultimatehint: Use the tornado to cross the gap!
info.name: Chaos I09 Avoiding Hazards

info.starthelptext: Don't slip off the level.
info.desc: A quick level to test your skills. Beware of the ice!
info.oldultimatehint: Find a good path for the start and you're set.
info.name: Chaos I08 Basic Agility Course

info.oldeasteregghint: It is on the other side of the ceiling. A gravity change and a Super Jump should do it.
info.starthelptext: Six faces to find the diamonds on!
info.oldultimatehint: Too many paths for this level, but I prefer taking the ceiling last.
info.name: Chaos I35 Battlecube Revisited
info.desc: Even though this level is easy are you capable of finding the best path?

info.starthelptext: Evade the bumps, making sure you don't fall off!
info.oldultimatehint: You can cross two gaps with ease if you use diagonal.
info.name: Chaos I25 Bumpy Highway
info.desc: Evade the bumps, making sure you don't fall off!
A level meant for shortcuts, but you can beat it the long way too.
info.oldeasteregghint: Try changing gravity and falling all the way down to the other side of where the start pad is.
info.oldultimatehint: You did train in loop exits, right?
info.name: Chaos I20 Byzantine Helix

info.starthelptext: Pick your shortcut!
info.desc: This level has so many shortcuts, it's not even funny!
info.oldultimatehint: Aim for the Super Jump and use it to the goal!
info.name: Chaos I21 Convoluted Helix

info.desc: Use the Tornadoes to your advantage!
info.name: Chaos I03 Tornado Launch
info.oldultimatehint: Patience is a virtue.
info.starthelptext: Use the tornadoes to your advantage!

info.oldultimatehint: Go to the blue island first, then pink. Wait for the Super Jump to respawn to exit the Havoc Zone faster with the help of the tornadoes straight into the teleporters.
info.name: Chaos I34 Daedal Helix
info.desc: This level requires quick thinking and a fast reaction time, as well as general skills.

info.starthelptext: Choose your path... or your shortcut.
info.oldeasteregghint: Behind the finish sign.
info.oldultimatehint: Stolen from MBU.
info.name: Chaos I33 Divergence
info.desc: All roads lead to the finish!
Roll around the inside of the rings to collect the gems.
info.oldeasteregghint: Below the gem under the rings. Change gravity or use a Super Speed.
info.oldultimatehint: Either start with the loops, or go down, it is your choice.
info.name: Chaos I15 Double LoopLoop

info.starthelptext: Inspired by Level Seven.
info.desc: Roll quickly down the slopes before time runs out!
info.oldeasteregghint: Find a Gyrocopter behind the green arrow sign, which you can get to by wall hitting the starting arch. Use that gyrocopter to fly to one of the towers on the left, where the egg is located.
info.oldultimatehint: Time your start and collect enough TTs.
info.name: Chaos I14 Downhill Racing

info.starthelptext: Climb to the top using rugs and carpets!
info.oldeasteregghint: When you're about more than halfway up, you should find it.
info.oldultimatehint: I like to use the last Super Speed from the very top, but that's just because it's fun.
info.name: Chaos I30 Dragged Up!
info.desc: Use the Super Speeds to help you get up to the end!

info.starthelptext: Go up the path and use the powerups to get to the next floor.
info.oldeasteregghint: Jump and double Super Jump high enough to reach it, but be careful, as you'll go out of bounds before getting it.
info.oldultimatehint: Use the Super Jump to get to the next floor from the sides.
info.name: Chaos I24 Floor Climb
info.desc: Up the floors we go!

info.starthelptext: Don't forget your towel!
info.oldeasteregghint: There is a hole that can be accessed via the roof, which you can reach by using a Super Speed. Fall through it.
info.oldultimatehint: Go to the left first, then bumpers, ice, the structure and finish with the fans/nuke bit.
info.name: Chaos I31 Gym
info.desc: Use your marble skills to find all the gems!

info.starthelptext: Use the Super Speeds ahead to your advantage!
info.desc: Loops have never been so much fun!
info.oldeasteregghint: You can loop exit and control your spin in the air to reach the top of the first loop.
info.oldultimatehint: You can loop exit straight to the finish!
info.name: Chaos I17 Loop Exits

info.starthelptext: Jump for the gems!
info.oldultimatehint: The gems in the small tubes in the centre of the map can be collected by simply rolling outside the tubes.
info.name: Chaos I28 Marble Agility Course
info.desc: Can you take it all in stride?

info.oldeasteregghint: Wall hit off the icy stairs to reach it.
info.oldultimatehint: You can escape the club!
info.desc: Pass the ice-covered challenges!
info.name: Chaos I07 Marble Mini Golf: Icichole
info.starthelptext: Aim carefully into the tunnel!

info.desc: Go through the castle's maze to find the gems!
info.name: Chaos I04 Medieval Maze
info.oldeasteregghint: This is a rather fun one to get. There is a secret passageway you can enter by using the first Super Jump you see, from the right side of the castle. It should lead you towards the egg at the end.
info.oldultimatehint: Go right first, then head towards the Super Jump.

info.name: Chaos I06 Marble Mini Golf
info.starthelptext: Beat the Par, the Birdie and the Eagle!
info.desc: Roll along this small, garden-style course.
info.oldeasteregghint: Gain as much speed as you can so you can hit the flower behind the start and gain enough height to reach to top of the arch.
info.oldultimatehint: Slow down as you jump onto the flower, you'll find it much easier.

info.desc: Ascend up the path and head for the finish!
info.name: Chaos I02 Mountaintop Retreat
info.oldeasteregghint: In the section where the Super Speed is, you can use it to reach a hole carved on one of the scenery pillars.
info.oldultimatehint: Stolen from MBU.
info.starthelptext: Ascend up the path and head for the finish!
You only get one chance at things here, don't lose it.
info.oldultimatehint: Use the Super Bounce powerup to hit the Gyrocopter and then hit the gem and skillshot the goal!
info.name: Chaos I26 Perplexingness
info.desc: Can you find the pathway for the Platinum Time on this perplexing level?

info.starthelptext: Don't forget to collect the gems!
info.desc: Practice your powerup skills!
info.oldeasteregghint: The apex of the level.
info.oldultimatehint: Use each powerup smartly.
info.name: Chaos I16 Powerup Practice

info.starthelptext: Use your brain! If you have one, that is.
info.oldeasteregghint: Use your brain to reach the top of the first arch. If you have one, that is.
info.oldultimatehint: Use your brain to find the shortcut! If you have one, that is.
info.name: Chaos I29 Puzzle Ordeal
info.desc: Can you figure out how to get past the obstacles?
Roll around the maze of ramps, collecting the gems!
info.name: Chaos I05 Ramp Madness
info.oldultimatehint: It's a simple route, but do the outside gems last.

info.desc: Lead the marble up the tricky trail but don't let the clock beat you!
info.oldeasteregghint: There is a Gravity Modifier behind where the Shock Absorber is. Once you've used it to change gravity, simply fall down to the egg when you find it.
info.oldultimatehint: There's a small shortcut to bypass some of the level.
info.name: Chaos I12 Roll Like the Wind!

info.starthelptext: Use your best marbling skills to pass the trials ahead!
info.oldeasteregghint: Behind the wall where the Shock Absorber is. Can you figure out how to get it?
info.oldultimatehint: From the Super Jump, get to the trapdoors' gem and use the Shock Absorber to get to the random floor's gem.
info.name: Chaos I32 Skill Zone
info.desc: Serious concentration and effort are needed here.

info.starthelptext: Make your way past the trials ahead to finish!
info.desc: Control your spin so you can collect the gems ahead!
info.oldeasteregghint: Wall hit to the roof!
info.oldultimatehint: Skip from one side to another!
info.name: Chaos I19 Spin Practice

info.desc: A short race for you and your friends.
info.oldeasteregghint: Aim carefully into the hole to the left of the ending arch.
info.oldultimatehint: Cut your path short and go fast on the tightropes.
info.name: Chaos I13 Sprint

info.starthelptext: Taking a stroll is not always easy...
info.desc: Move and jump carefully up and around the platforms, making sure you control your spin!
info.oldeasteregghint: Jump off a sloped edging to reach it.
info.oldultimatehint: You can still cross the gap!
info.name: Chaos I11 Take a Stroll...

info.starthelptext: Be careful on trim...
info.desc: Be careful around the tornado...
info.oldeasteregghint: There is a Gyrocopter below the tornado. Use it to fling yourself up to the egg.
info.oldultimatehint: Did you know I have sub-10? That's because I used the tornado and the trim.
info.name: Chaos I10 Technoropes

info.desc: Can you make it to the finish in time?
info.name: Chaos I27 Timely Ascent
info.oldeasteregghint: If you observe the level from the start, you should see it if you look closely enough.
info.oldultimatehint: In MBU they wall hit, in MBP we edge hit.

info.desc: Welcome to the Intermediate Levels!
info.name: Chaos I01 Triple Decker
info.oldeasteregghint: Need for the Super Speed.
info.oldultimatehint: No need for the Super Speed.
info.starthelptext: Go around the 3 story building, collecting the gems!
Collect the gems in the building by bouncing off the walls!
info.desc: Master your wall-hitting skills!
info.oldultimatehint: I found it faster to make a sign hit, but its harder.
info.name: Chaos I18 Wall Master

info.oldultimatehint: There should be some points where you don't stop jumping.
info.name: Chaos I23 Winding Steps
info.desc: Perfect your jumping skills.

info.name: Chaos A16 Beach Party
info.desc: Zoom through this fun, Gravity Modfier-packed course!
info.oldultimatehint: You sure you need the first Gravity Modifier?
info.oldeasteregghint: You'll definitely need the first Gravity Modifier. Fall off the ideal path once you do so.

info.starthelptext: Activate the powerups at the right time in order to pass the ordeals ahead!
info.name: Chaos A27 Combo Course
info.desc: Put your powerup skills to the ultimate test!
info.oldultimatehint: Think well on how to use each powerup. Not all challenges need the two powerups available.
info.oldeasteregghint: Fly to once of the holes behind where the fourth challenge is.

info.oldultimatehint: Cut through bits of the level
info.oldeasteregghint: Under one of the twisted platforms.
info.starthelptext: Can you do it?
info.name: Chaos A14 Crash Course
info.desc: A small yet challenging course to test your skills.

info.oldultimatehint: Trap your way to the finish, the intended way.
info.oldeasteregghint: You'll need to do a traplaunch for this one.
info.starthelptext: When times get tough, don't lose hope!
info.name: Chaos A30 Despair
info.desc: Stay on the platform to pass the level!

info.oldultimatehint: There's more than one path, and you have more than enough time bonus to use.
info.oldeasteregghint: Look behind one of the walls. The wall in question stands out.
info.starthelptext: Explore around for the hidden gems!
info.name: Chaos A02 Gem Seeking Fun!
info.desc: Go around the platforms searching for the gems! Look out for hidden Time Travels! And don't forget, you have two minutes!

info.oldultimatehint: Jumping does help!
info.oldeasteregghint: Near the end of the level. Approach it with caution.
info.starthelptext: Jumping as you roll onto a slope might help you climb them.
info.name: Chaos A10 Fighting Slopes
info.desc: Can you make it up the slopes without falling off the bottom?

info.starthelptext: Collect the gems, but don't rush!
info.name: Chaos A23 Frictional Ascent
info.desc: Ascend to the top while traversing the hazardous friction and collecting the gems, but don't rush!
info.oldultimatehint: Amazingly there is a shortcut, just find a method to save that Jump Boost.
info.oldeasteregghint: Get plenty of height off the icy half pipe to reach a secret area.

info.starthelptext: Roll and jump around but don't slip off the level!
info.name: Chaos A35 Frictional Battlecube
info.desc: Master the friction surfaces!
info.oldultimatehint: The old version of the level was way harder. After the ice melts, it becomes water.
info.oldeasteregghint: Behind the sandy side. A Super Speed can help, but it might be tough.

info.oldultimatehint: Go diagonally and make a special start to skillshot this UT.
info.oldeasteregghint: Overshoot the finish!
info.starthelptext: One-Way Skillshot!
info.name: Chaos A03 Gap Aimer
info.desc: Use the Gyrocopter to help you aim to the goal!

info.name: Chaos A24 Ice Cold Pass
info.desc: Pass through the swerving path of the cold pass.
info.oldultimatehint: From start to finish in a single hit
info.oldeasteregghint: You'll need to walk on a few tighropes, and fall off.

info.oldultimatehint: Hit the edge and come back the way you came. Don't travel on the other side of the big gap after the loop!
info.oldeasteregghint: The very top, much like Slope Madness.
info.starthelptext:
Pay attention to messages.
They will help you to complete the level correctly.
info.name: Chaos A13 Lightning Ice
info.desc: An amazingly speedy and short challenge. Pay attention to the help messages - they are very important!

info.name: Chaos A25 Michael's Adventure: MBP!
info.desc: Michael's Adventure strikes again!
info.oldultimatehint: Disregard the marble's safety on tightropes.
info.oldeasteregghint: One of the corners of the level behind the start. A nuke hit should do it.

info.desc: An unforgettable moving platform challenge.
info.name: Chaos A31 Morph
info.starthelptext: Follow the arrows and watch this level morph before your eyes.
info.oldultimatehint: The only thing here to rely on is speed.
info.oldeasteregghint: This is a fun one. When you reach the finish, you'll activate the entrance to inside the castle, where the egg resides.

info.oldultimatehint: Find a route to skip parts of the level fast. Use the gyrocopter more than once if needed.
info.oldeasteregghint: The only scenery pillar in the level is where the egg is. Fly to its dark side.
info.starthelptext: A small course to test your skills.
info.name: Chaos A15 NeonTech
info.desc: Progress along the uber-styled, technical floors!

info.oldultimatehint: Try and get gems in one jump. Control your spin, if that helps.
info.oldeasteregghint: On top of the finish sign. Nuke hit your way up there.
info.starthelptext:
Danger!
You're now entering a Nuke Field Zone!
info.name: Chaos A08 Nuke Field
info.desc: Get the gems and Time Travels but don't get blown away!

info.oldultimatehint: Memorize the locations of what you need.
info.oldeasteregghint: The smiley face has a nose.
info.starthelptext: Find the gems without putting in any flags!
info.name: Chaos A05 Nukesweeper
info.desc:
Play the next generation game of Minesweeper, called Nukesweeper!
Play the demo today!

info.oldultimatehint: Grab the nearest Gravity Modifier first, then instead of going the full route go down and hit another Gravity Modifier to go back to normal gravity with the 2nd gem at hand.
info.oldeasteregghint: Get a Super Jump, then go back to the starting section and use it to reach behind the top of the level.
info.starthelptext: Search for the gems quickly; you don't have much time!
info.name: Chaos A04 Orange-Fold Maze
info.desc: More of a course combined with a small strategy involved.

info.oldultimatehint: Ask a Pathway Finder to help you here.
info.oldeasteregghint: Touch the end pad to grab a secret Super Jump. Use it to reach the top of the level.
info.starthelptext: Be hasty!
info.name: Chaos A20 Par Pit
info.desc: Get all the gems before time runs out!

info.oldultimatehint: Go fast, there're barely any shortcuts here
info.oldeasteregghint: Stolen from Upward Spiral MBU.
info.starthelptext: Be careful!
info.name: Chaos A18 Perilous Road
info.desc: Follow the road to the top.

info.oldultimatehint: I recall Matan and Lonestar doing an awesome path on YouTube.
info.oldeasteregghint: Once you change gravity, go off the beaten path.
info.starthelptext: Find the Gyrocopter PowerUp and use it to your advantage!
info.name: Chaos A01 Pink-Fold Maze
info.desc: Collect the gems and the time modifiers to score the best possible time!

info.oldultimatehint: Wait for it to respawn.
info.oldeasteregghint: Save the Super Jump for the fourth section.
info.starthelptext: Get the gem at each stop in under 15 seconds, or the platform will leave you behind!!
info.name: Chaos A09 Platform Race
info.desc: You need good speed and agility for this one.

info.oldultimatehint: Get on the platform and off the platform ASAP. If you manage the traplaunch and the route for sub-1 minute... wow!
info.oldeasteregghint: Find a way to reach the top of the tower.
info.starthelptext: Do you feel the pressure?
info.name: Chaos A21 Platform Race 2
info.desc: Get the gem at each stop in 10 seconds or the platform shall leave you behind!

info.oldultimatehint: The key is to jump...
info.oldeasteregghint: Fall off one of the holes.
info.starthelptext: Just hang on, marble!
info.name: Chaos A22 Quaked Path
info.desc: Follow the path moving back and forth! The key is not to jump...

info.starthelptext: Can you handle the randomness?
info.name: Chaos A34 Random Mayhem
info.desc: Navigate your marble to its destinations while fighting off the hardest force of them all!
info.oldultimatehint: Amazingly, at some points if you go at a certain direction, it will just help you go straightforwards in the direction you wanted. Use the sloped edges to stop your marble on each island. Ah, you did practice your spin, right?
info.oldeasteregghint: Use a Super Speed to reach the top of the finish sign.

info.oldultimatehint: You can hit with the gyrocopter and slant and then hit the next gem and the ring instead of going normally. Then, grab all the gems on the last part and bounce twice to the finish!
info.starthelptext: Be sure you have the right speed and height before going through the rings!
info.name: Chaos A19 Ring Stunts
info.desc: Jump or fly through the rings to get the gems.

info.starthelptext: Use the sloped edging to your advantage!
info.name: Chaos A33 Rolling to Eternity
info.desc: Collect all ten gems by going through a variety of obstacles!
info.oldultimatehint: Use the checkpoint and the super jump to your advantage.
info.oldeasteregghint: Stolen from Daedalus MBU.

info.oldultimatehint: You can cut off some of the path.
info.oldeasteregghint: You should see it. Do an edge hit.
info.starthelptext: Take care when crossing the ice.
info.name: Chaos A11 Slippery Steps
info.desc: Steps can be slippery.

info.oldultimatehint: Go all the way to the other side first and then get to the last gem where the teleporter is.
info.oldeasteregghint: Hidden in the left section of the level.
info.name: Chaos A17 Slip Up
info.desc: You'll have to control your spin in these varying friction challenges!

info.oldultimatehint: Get a good path and go fast!
info.oldeasteregghint: The very top. Use a Super Jump and a Gyrocopter.
info.starthelptext: Slopes have never been so much fun!
info.name: Chaos A12 Slope Madness
info.desc: Use the available powerups and your best marbling skills to get all the gems.

info.starthelptext: Keep in mind that you will need to conquer some of the techniques ahead.
info.name: Chaos A29 Strategy Climb
info.desc: Move your way to climb up the challenging path ahead!
info.oldultimatehint: Jump early for the TT.
info.oldeasteregghint: Behind the section where you change gravity.

info.oldultimatehint: You can find more Time Travels than it might seem.
info.oldeasteregghint: Stolen from Upward Spiral MBU.
info.name: Chaos A07 Swivel
info.desc: Swivel around the holes, loops and bumpers!

info.starthelptext: Beware; there are traps and obstacles galore in this castle!
info.name: Chaos A32 Thief
info.desc: Invade the castle and steal all the gems within before time runs out!
info.oldultimatehint: Ever hit a nuke with a gyrocopter? Try it, you get tons of height.
info.oldeasteregghint: Nuke hit to one of the scenery castles.

info.starthelptext: Collect the gems and get to the finish without falling.
info.name: Chaos A26 Treacherous Path
info.desc: Can you make it past the treacherous hazards?
info.oldultimatehint: Start the path normally, skip to the end and then do the level backwards.
info.oldeasteregghint: Fall off a trapdoor.

info.oldultimatehint: Hit the TT first, go back [after passing the goal] and edge hit to the first gem and do the level in order. Of course you can cut off some bits.
info.oldeasteregghint: Behind the finish sign.
info.starthelptext: Jump past the obstacles ahead!
info.name: Chaos A06 Treachery
info.desc: Jump past the platform obstacles to survive!

info.starthelptext: Make sure to maintain your balance on the treacherous branches!
info.name: Chaos A28 Ultimate Tree
info.desc: Explore this beautiful tree and collect the gems on the branches.
info.oldultimatehint: Decide on a route which will collect everything. Most of the TTs will be useful.
info.oldeasteregghint: Between the two elevators inside the trunk. Maybe a Gyrocopter should do it.

info.desc: Fly around this bizarre structure! Accuracy, precision and strength are needed.
info.name: Chaos E18 Arch Acropolis
info.oldultimatehint: Read the description carefully.
info.oldeasteregghint: Fly to behind one of the scenery towers. The egg is located under the roof though.

info.oldultimatehint: The hardest there is. Find a path that you can memorize and once you run out of gems to remember, just try and memorize which floors you should go to next. Ah, the gyrocopters will come in handy. Be patient, and practice a lot, this isn't going to be an easy ride. Last tip: Make sure you have a lot of spare time, this will take a while to beat.
info.oldeasteregghint: It is inside the finish sign. If you don't know exactly where to Super Jump, it can be difficult to get.
info.name: Chaos E25 Battlecube Finale
info.starthelptext: Race against the clock on all twelve faces of this mad level!
info.desc: Can you make your way through the final battle?

info.name: Chaos E09 Bouncing Fun
info.oldultimatehint: Complete each part fast and get all the TTs.
info.oldeasteregghint: Precisely roll behind the slanted bouncy floor in Part 3.
info.desc: Pass each bouncy challenge to finish!
If one may fall or go to the sides, but not too far, the teleporter shall put them back to the start.
info.name: Chaos E15 Cardcaddy's Gem Collection
info.oldultimatehint: Ends up there's an easy path and that the platforms go in order. Find that order.
info.oldeasteregghint: Use a Super Jump to reach the top of one of the swaying scenery pillars. But be careful, you'll need perfect timing.
info.starthelptext: Up and down all night long!
Can you maintain your balance long enough to make it to the end?
info.desc: Good balancing skills are the key to success here!
info.name: Chaos E20 Catwalks
info.oldultimatehint: Ever hit a nuke and landed on a tightrope? Fear not for the marble's safety. For a faster time, think what you can do with the gravity modifiers.
info.oldeasteregghint: Save a Super Jump for when you reach the first checkpoint. Use it to grab the egg from under the tightrope.

info.name: Chaos E06 Dizzying Heights
info.starthelptext: Don't look down!
info.oldultimatehint: Honestly, as if the answer couldn't be more obvious! Or perhaps the ice slipped it away?
info.desc: Climb to the top of the tower while avoiding the hazards.
You're used to jumping, but what will you do when you just can't risk it?
info.name: Chaos E16 Don't Jump!
info.starthelptext: Only now will you realise how important the jumping ability was, won't you?
info.oldultimatehint: Take risks and use the checkpoint to your advantage, if you can.
info.oldeasteregghint: You should be able to see it right as when you start of the level. Use a fan to lift you there after you jump.

info.name: Chaos E07 Gyrocopter Monster Course
info.starthelptext: Welcome to the Gyrocopter Monster Course!
info.oldultimatehint: Collect all the TTs, both large and small.
info.desc: Shape up your Gyrocopter skills!

info.oldultimatehint: It's another one of Phil's levels, of course it has shortcuts.
info.oldeasteregghint: After the small bouncy floor section, you should see it in one of the corners of the scenery pillars.
info.name: Chaos E23 Mastering the Marble
info.starthelptext: Can you master the challenges awaiting you?
info.desc: You made it so far, but how good really are you with your marble skills? Master the marble, beat the course.

info.oldultimatehint: Go right to the half pipe first, skillshot a TT on a tightrope and then get to the 2nd gem first.
info.oldeasteregghint: Of all the scenery towers in the level, the blue one stands out.
info.desc: The biggest adventure of all!
info.name: Chaos E03 Michael's Final Adventure!

info.oldultimatehint: Memorize your path, big time.
info.oldeasteregghint: This is one of the more memorable ones. Stay inside one of the boxes with a gem inside of it. If you wait long enough, the platform will take you down to a secret room. Figure out which of the boxes in it has the egg.
info.desc: Test your memory in this fast-paced game. Find all the gems without putting in any flags!
info.name: Chaos E05 Nukesweeper Revisited
info.starthelptext: If you go into a wrong square, it could spell 'Game Over'.

info.oldultimatehint: Amazingly, there is a path.
info.oldeasteregghint: This one is really fun. Change gravity at the end of the left section of the level. You should then see a Gyrocopter and a Super Jump on the half pipe of the scenery arch. Touching it will activate a white moving platform. Use both powerups to reach the section where it was activated. Touching that section will activate the next white platform, rinse and repeat. Follow them until you eventually reach the egg.
info.name: Chaos E13 Platform Mayhem
info.starthelptext: That is so not your everyday level!
info.desc: Whoever built this level is probably a two year old baby!

info.name: Chaos E08 Recoil Ultra Course
info.starthelptext:
Welcome to the Recoil Ultra Course!
Get the gems on each challenge. Get each Time Travel to get the best time!
info.oldultimatehint: Go fast and collect all TTs. Try not to fail anything.
info.oldeasteregghint: Behind one of the walls near the end of the level. Change gravity to reach it.
info.desc: Put all your recoiling skills to the ultimate test!

info.name: Chaos E12 Sand Storm
info.oldultimatehint: Speed is all you need. The rest will be aligned. Also, it's Phil's level, expect a shortcut, even if not obvious.
info.oldeasteregghint: Use a secret Gyrocopter to reach a lonely platform where the egg is.
info.desc: Pass through the blowing, pushing and bending fort!

info.starthelptext: Don't look down!
info.desc: Slow and steady does the trick.
info.name: Chaos E19 Slowropes
info.oldultimatehint: Ever went very fast on tightropes? Try it here.
I hit a 6:08 while missing the 8 and 15 secs TTs and having a double respawn. UT should be fine for you then. Also, there are small shortcuts along your route... A Phil's level or what? :)
info.oldeasteregghint: You can actually find the moon in this level. All you have to do to reach it is find a teleporter behind a slanted bouncy platform. Disappointingly, it isn't made of cheese.
info.name: Chaos E24 Space Station
info.starthelptext: Good luck, but remember you can't get any help.
info.desc: Enter the Space Station, explore the planets. Do you have the energy for this mission?

info.name: Chaos E10 Speed Attack
info.oldultimatehint: Like the rest, it's to collect as many TTs as possible and to go fast.
info.oldeasteregghint: It is actually vital that you don't outrun the teleporter at the end of the level. You will be sent to a lonely ice platform where the egg is.
info.desc: Train in the way of the Super Speed!

info.oldultimatehint: Did you find the hidden gyrocopter?
info.oldeasteregghint: Fall off the platform where the finish pad is to reach it.
info.desc: Make your way by using skills and techniques! You don't have much time, so try to qualify!
info.name: Chaos E01 Stamina

info.starthelptext: Gigantic, isn't it?
info.desc:
You've never seen such a skyscraper before, have you?
Climb to the top, if you dare.
info.name: Chaos E22 The Tale of the Tall Skyscraper
info.oldultimatehint: Try and not fall off. Also, keep in mind there are 3 easy shortcuts.
info.oldeasteregghint: Navigate the first floor of the skyscraper itself, and hug the wall until you trigger a secret door. Follow it.

info.name: Chaos E11 The Time Travel Race
info.starthelptext: The race is on!
info.oldultimatehint: I'm not left handed, but this level likes the left.
info.oldeasteregghint: This one always fascinated me (the one writing this, Blasted). There is a Gyrocopter and a Super Jump behind the end pad. Use both to fly up to a tower with another Gyrocopter and Super Jump on top of it. Use those to fly to yet another tower with both powerups. Keep going until you reach a lonely platform with the egg on it.
info.desc: Collect the Time Travels throughout this race and finish before the Par Time.

info.oldultimatehint: Don't slip off the level!
info.oldeasteregghint: The roof of the finish house.
info.name: Chaos E21 The Ultimate Friction Challenge!
info.starthelptext: Welcome to the Ultimate Friction Challenge!
info.desc: The iciest and slipperiest level you will ever play!

info.starthelptext: Keep moving so that you don't fall through the trapdoors!
info.desc: Get to the end without falling through!
info.name: Chaos E17 Trapdoor Mania
info.oldultimatehint: Edge hit but don't slow down!
Start by clearing the left side first and then the right side from top to bottom.
info.oldeasteregghint: Under one of the tightslopes.
info.desc: Only elite marblers dare venture the treacherous complexities!
info.name: Chaos E04 Trigonometry

info.oldultimatehint: Just one maze to solve.
info.oldeasteregghint: Change gravity and go outside the pipes. The egg should be in sight.
info.desc: Not one but two mazes to solve!
info.name: Chaos E02 Tunnel Vision
info.starthelptext: Pipes just got ugly...

info.desc:
Wall-hit to the top in less than 100 seconds!
Don't get too frustrated!
info.name: Chaos E14 Uphill Racing
info.oldultimatehint: Thank god I didn't use Pascal's sub-20 pathway when setting this Ultimate Time.
info.oldeasteregghint: Probably my favortie egg of the bunch. Much like Downhill Racing, there's a Gyrocopter behind the arrow sign. Use it to reach the top of the tower behind where the start pad is. You'll need plenty of momentum before the wall hit, though.
info.starthelptext: Level Nineteen Inspired Level Seven.

info.desc: Not everything is as it seems!

remarks: bounce on bumpers one to another!

info.name: Race to the goal

info.starthelptext: Ready..Set..Go!

info.desc: Take a stroll on this path, but don't fall off!

The reference size of the marble I am using is 13mm, even though the actual size of a marble in MBG is 18.9cm (which is unrealistic)

info.starthelptext: be "careful"

info.desc: Stupid level
Not everything is as it seems!
info.name: Bent Reality - No TTs
info.starthelptext: Don't trust your senses! Take your chances!

info.desc: You're in a castle wars game! Get to the other team's castle, then go back home because they have nothing of value.
info.name: Castle Wars! - No Gems
info.starthelptext: This game of castle wars begins now!

info.desc: How fast can you find the finish pad? Probably pretty quickly, it's kinda just right there.
info.name: Cubed Maze - No Gems

info.desc: Dedicated to Technostick who simply cannot stand long levels.
info.name: Diamond Travel - No Gems or TTs
info.starthelptext: Take your time!

info.name: Dual Perspectives - No Gems or TTs
info.desc: Make sure you explore both sides of this crazy level!
info.starthelptext: Can you find the best path?

info.desc: Reach the second floor of this building then head for the finish!
info.name: Excalibur - No Gems or TTs
info.starthelptext: Pretty easy if you know how to do it!

info.name: Getting Squeezed - No Gems
info.starthelptext: Use the Anti-Recoils to stop yourself from bouncing off platforms.
info.desc: Squeeze yourself between moving platforms to give yourself a big boost!
Warning:  EXCESSIVE EXPOSURE CAN CAUSE DISORIENTATION AND HEADACHES.
info.name: Gravity Shaker - No Gems

info.starthelptext: Collect all the diamonds that are not there.
info.desc: Level Dedicated to Cardcaddy
info.name: Half Pipe Dive - No Gems
Happy Birthday! - No Gems
info.desc: After the candles will be blown up, collect the presents hidden in them!
info.starthelptext: A special birthday level for a special Marble Blast friend!

info.desc: Travel along this beautiful, vast icy world down the crystal slopes.
info.name: Ice Diamond - No TTs
info.starthelptext: Speed to the finish but don't break the ice!

info.desc: Your Marble has been magnetized. Stay away from magnets or be pulled out of bounds. It's your choice.
info.name: Magnetic Adventure - No Gems
info.starthelptext: Move Forward and Back to break free.
Follow the signs!
info.name: Master the Jump Boost - No Gems
info.desc: Timing and spin control are essential.
A mini marble golf level which wasn't good for me...
info.name: Mini Marble Golf - DC - No TTs
info.starthelptext: Get to the finish as fast as you can!

info.desc: Mess with gravity at your peril!
info.starthelptext: Watch out for the Gravity Defyers!
info.name: Newton Knew Best... - No Gems

info.desc: Climb to the top of the 2-D world!
info.name: Platformer - No Gems

info.desc: Don't you love going to the pool? Especially when its not filled with random sharp jewelry.
info.name: Pool - No Gems or TTs

info.desc: The easiest way to pass such courses is to not to touch any controls!
info.name: Rube Goldberg Course - No Gems
info.starthelptext: If, by chance, the marble stops completely, press a bit forwards and let the fun continue!

info.desc: Travel in and out the sanctuary!
info.name: Sanctuary - No Gems or TTs
info.starthelptext: May God help you along your route!

info.desc: Master your stair climbing skills!
info.name: Stairmaster - No Gems
info.starthelptext: Whoever invented stairs sure wasn't a marble.

info.desc: Finish in this box as fast as you can! ...Finish pad. Get to the finish pad.
info.name: Trampoline Box - No Gems

info.ultimatehint: Did you find the hidden gyrocopter?
info.easteregghint: Fall off the platform where the finish pad is to reach it.
info.desc: Make your way by using skills and techniques! You don't have much time, so try to qualify!
info.name: Stamina - No Gems or TTs

info.ultimatehint: Just one maze to solve.
info.easteregghint: Change gravity and go outside the pipes. The egg should be in sight.
info.desc: Not one but zero mazes to solve!
info.name: Tunnel Vision - No Gems or TTs
info.starthelptext: Pipes just got ugly...

info.ultimatehint: Go right to the half pipe first, skillshot a TT on a tightrope and then get to the 2nd gem first.
info.easteregghint: Of all the scenery towers in the level, the blue one stands out.
info.desc: The smallest adventure of all!
info.name: Michael's Final Adventure! - No Gems or TTs

info.ultimatehint: Start by clearing the left side first and then the right side from top to bottom.
info.easteregghint: Under one of the tightslopes.
info.desc: Only elite marblers dare venture the treacherous complexities!
info.name: Trigonometry - No Gems

info.ultimatehint: Memorize your path, big time.
info.easteregghint: This is one of the more memorable ones. Stay inside one of the boxes with a gem inside of it. If you wait long enough, the platform will take you down to a secret room. Figure out which of the boxes in it has the egg.
info.desc: Test your goldfish memory in this fast-paced game. Find the finish pad without putting in any flags!
info.name: Nukesweeper Revisited - No Gems or TTs
info.starthelptext: If you go into a wrong square, it could spell 'Game Over'.

info.name: Dizzying Heights - No TTs
info.starthelptext: Don't look down!
info.ultimatehint: Honestly, as if the answer couldn't be more obvious! Or perhaps the ice slipped it away?
info.desc: Climb halfway up the tower while avoiding the hazards and then stop avoiding them.

info.name: Gyrocopter Monster Course - No Gems or TTs
info.starthelptext: Welcome to the Gyrocopter Monster Course!
info.ultimatehint: Collect all the TTs, both large and small.
info.desc: Shape up your Gyrocopter skills!

info.name: Recoil Ultra Course - No Gems or TTs
info.starthelptext:
Welcome to the Recoil Ultra Course!
Get each [REDACTED] to get the best time!
info.ultimatehint: Go fast and collect all TTs. Try not to fail anything.
info.easteregghint: Behind one of the walls near the end of the level. Change gravity to reach it.
info.desc: Put all your recoiling skills to the ultimate test!

info.name: Bouncing Fun - No Gems or TTs
info.ultimatehint: Complete each part fast and get all the TTs.
info.easteregghint: Precisely roll behind the slanted bouncy floor in Part 3.
info.desc: Pass each bouncy challenge to finish!

info.name: Speed Attack - No Gems or TTs
info.ultimatehint: Like the rest, it's to collect as many TTs as possible and to go fast.
info.easteregghint: It is actually vital that you don't outrun the teleporter at the end of the level. You will be sent to a lonely ice platform where the egg is.
info.desc: Train in the way of the Super Speed!

info.name: The Time Travel Race - No TTs
info.starthelptext: The race is on!
info.ultimatehint: I'm not left handed, but this level likes the left.
info.easteregghint: This one always fascinated me (the one writing this, Blasted). There is a Gyrocopter and a Super Jump behind the end pad. Use both to fly up to a tower with another Gyrocopter and Super Jump on top of it. Use those to fly to yet another tower with both powerups. Keep going until you reach a lonely platform with the egg on it.
info.desc: Good luck.

info.name: Sand Storm - No Gems or TTs
info.ultimatehint: Speed is all you need. The rest will be aligned. Also, it's Phil's level, expect a shortcut, even if not obvious.
info.easteregghint: Use a secret Gyrocopter to reach a lonely platform where the egg is.
info.desc: Pass through the blowing, pushing and bending fort!

info.ultimatehint: Amazingly, there is a path.
info.easteregghint: This one is really fun. Change gravity at the end of the left section of the level. You should then see a Gyrocopter and a Super Jump on the half pipe of the scenery arch. Touching it will activate a white moving platform. Use both powerups to reach the section where it was activated. Touching that section will activate the next white platform, rinse and repeat. Follow them until you eventually reach the egg.
info.name: Platform Mayhem - No Gems or TTs
info.starthelptext: That is so not your everyday level!
info.desc: Whoever built this level is probably a 6 month old fetus!

Wall-hit to the top in less than 100 seconds!
Don't get too frustrated!
info.name: Uphill Racing - No TTs
info.ultimatehint: Thank god I didn't use Pascal's sub-20 pathway when setting this Ultimate Time.
info.easteregghint: Probably my favortie egg of the bunch. Much like Downhill Racing, there's a Gyrocopter behind the arrow sign. Use it to reach the top of the tower behind where the start pad is. You'll need plenty of momentum before the wall hit, though.
info.starthelptext: Level Nineteen Inspired Level Seven.

info.desc: Cardcaddy decided to sell his collection on Ebay, but got scammed with a fake payment email.
info.name: Cardcaddy's Gem Collection - No Gems or TTs
info.ultimatehint: Ends up there's an easy path and that the platforms go in order. Find that order.
info.easteregghint: Use a Super Jump to reach the top of one of the swaying scenery pillars. But be careful, you'll need perfect timing.
info.starthelptext: Up and down all night long!

info.desc: You're used to jumping, but what will you do when you just can't risk it?
info.name: Don't Jump! - No TTs
info.starthelptext: Only now will you realise how important the jumping ability was, won't you?
info.ultimatehint: Take risks and use the checkpoint to your advantage, if you can.
info.easteregghint: You should be able to see it right as when you start of the level. Use a fan to lift you there after you jump.

info.desc: Fly around this bizarre structure! Not much strength is needed.
info.name: Arch Acropolis - No Gems or TTs
info.ultimatehint: Read the description carefully.
info.easteregghint: Fly to behind one of the scenery towers. The egg is located under the roof though.

info.starthelptext: Don't look down!
info.desc: Slow and steady does the trick.
info.name: Slowropes - No Gems or TTs
info.ultimatehint: Ever went very fast on tightropes? Try it here.

info.starthelptext: Can you maintain your balance long enough to make it to the end?
info.desc: Good balancing skills are the key to success here!
info.name: Catwalks - No Gems
info.ultimatehint: Ever hit a nuke and landed on a tightrope? Fear not for the marble's safety. For a faster time, think what you can do with the gravity modifiers.
info.easteregghint: Save a Super Jump for when you reach the first checkpoint. Use it to grab the egg from under the tightrope.

info.ultimatehint: Don't slip off the level!
info.easteregghint: The roof of the finish house.
info.name: The Ultimate Friction Challenge! - No Gems or TTs
info.starthelptext: Welcome to the Ultimate Friction Challenge!
info.desc: The iciest and slipperiest level you will ever play!

info.starthelptext: Gigantic, isn't it?
info.desc:
You've seen such a skyscraper before, have you?
Climb to the top, if you feel like it.
info.name: The Tale of the Tall Skyscraper - No Gems or TTs
info.ultimatehint: Try and not fall off. Also, keep in mind there are 3 easy shortcuts.
info.easteregghint: Navigate the first floor of the skyscraper itself, and hug the wall until you trigger a secret door. Follow it.

info.ultimatehint: It's another one of Phil's levels, of course it has shortcuts.
info.easteregghint: After the small bouncy floor section, you should see it in one of the corners of the scenery pillars.
info.name: Mastering the Marble - No Gems or TTs
info.starthelptext: Can you master the challenges awaiting you?
info.desc: You made it so far, but how good really are you with your marble skills? Master the marble, beat the course.

info.ultimatehint: I hit a 6:08 while missing the 8 and 15 secs TTs and having a double respawn. UT should be fine for you then. Also, there are small shortcuts along your route... A Phil's level or what? :)
info.easteregghint: You can actually find the moon in this level. All you have to do to reach it is find a teleporter behind a slanted bouncy platform. Disappointingly, it isn't made of cheese.
info.name: Space Station - No Gems or TTs
info.starthelptext: Good luck, but remember you can't get any help. Unless you're in the Marble Blast discord, of course.
info.desc: Enter the Space Station, explore the planets. Do you have the energy for this mission?

info.ultimatehint: The hardest there is. Find a path that you can memorize and once you run out of gems to remember, just try and memorize which floors you should go to next. Ah, the gyrocopters will come in handy. Be patient, and practice a lot, this isn't going to be an easy ride. Last tip: Make sure you have a lot of spare time, this will take a while to beat.
info.easteregghint: It is inside the finish sign. If you don't know exactly where to Super Jump, it can be difficult to get.
info.name: Battlecube Finale - No Gems or TTs
info.starthelptext: Race against the clock on all twelve faces of this mad level!
info.desc: Can you make your way through the final battle? Probably.

info.ultimatehint: I recall Matan and Lonestar doing an awesome path on YouTube.
info.easteregghint: Once you change gravity, go off the beaten path.
info.starthelptext: Find the Gyrocopter PowerUp and use it to your advantage!
info.name: Pink-Fold Maze - No Gems or TTs
info.desc: Collect the time modifiers to score the best possible time!

info.ultimatehint: There's more than one path, and you have more than enough time bonus to use.
info.easteregghint: Look behind one of the walls. The wall in question stands out.
info.starthelptext: Just keep looking!
info.name: Gem Seeking Fun! - No Gems or TTs
info.desc: Explore around for the gems! You'll find one eventually, I'm sure!

info.ultimatehint: Grab the nearest Gravity Modifier first, then instead of going the full route go down and hit another Gravity Modifier to go back to normal gravity with the 2nd gem at hand.
info.easteregghint: Get a Super Jump, then go back to the starting section and use it to reach behind the top of the level.
info.starthelptext: Search for the finish at a medium pace; you have some time.
info.name: Orange-Fold Maze - No Gems or TTs
info.desc: More of a course combined with a small strategy involved.

info.ultimatehint: Memorize the locations of what you need.
info.easteregghint: The smiley face has a nose.
info.starthelptext: Find the finish pad without putting in any flags!
info.name: Nukesweeper - No Gems or TTs
info.desc:
Play the next generation game of Minesweeper, called Nukesweeper!
Play the demo today!

info.ultimatehint: Hit the TT first, go back [after passing the goal] and edge hit to the first gem and do the level in order. Of course you can cut off some bits.
info.easteregghint: Behind the finish sign.
info.starthelptext: Jump past the obstacles ahead!
info.name: Treachery - No Gems or TTs
info.desc: Jump past the platform obstacles to survive!

info.ultimatehint: You can find more Time Travels than it might seem.
info.easteregghint: Stolen from Upward Spiral MBU.
info.name: Swivel - No TTs
info.desc: Swivel around the holes, loops and bumpers!

info.ultimatehint: Try and get gems in one jump. Control your spin, if that helps.
info.easteregghint: On top of the finish sign. Nuke hit your way up there.
info.starthelptext:
Danger!
You're now entering a Nuke Field Zone!
info.name: Nuke Field - No Gems or TTs
info.desc: Don't get blown away!

info.ultimatehint: Wait for it to respawn.
info.easteregghint: Save the Super Jump for the fourth section.
info.starthelptext: Stay at each stop for 15 seconds, or the platform will leave you behind!!
info.name: Platform Race - No Gems
info.desc: You need pretty much no speed or agility for this one.

info.ultimatehint: Jumping does help!
info.easteregghint: Near the end of the level. Approach it with caution.
info.starthelptext: Jumping as you roll onto a slope might help you climb them.
info.name: Fighting Slopes - No Gems
info.desc: Can you make it up the slopes without falling off the bottom?

info.ultimatehint: You can cut off some of the path.
info.easteregghint: You should see it. Do an edge hit.
info.starthelptext: Take care when crossing the ice.
info.name: Slippery Steps - No Gems
info.desc: Steps can be slippery.

info.ultimatehint: Get a good path and go fast!
info.easteregghint: The very top. Use a Super Jump and a Gyrocopter.
info.starthelptext: Slopes have never been so much fun!
info.name: Slope Madness - No Gems or TTs
info.desc: Use your best marbling skills to get past the wooden pole in the way.

info.ultimatehint: Hit the edge and come back the way you came. Don't travel on the other side of the big gap after the loop!
info.easteregghint: The very top, much like Slope Madness.
info.starthelptext:
Don't pay attention to messages.
They will help you to complete the level incorrectly.
info.name: Lightning Ice - No Gems or TTs
info.desc: An amazingly short challenge. Don't pay attention to the help messages - they are not very important!

info.ultimatehint: Cut through bits of the level
info.easteregghint: Under one of the twisted platforms.
info.starthelptext: Can you do it?
info.name: Crash Course - No Gems or TTs
info.desc: A small yet challenging course to test your skills.

info.ultimatehint: Find a route to skip parts of the level fast. Use the gyrocopter more than once if needed.
info.easteregghint: The only scenery pillar in the level is where the egg is. Fly to its dark side.
info.starthelptext: A small course to test your skills.
info.name: NeonTech - No Gems or TTs
info.desc: Progress along the uber-styled, technical floors!

info.name: Beach Party - No Gems or TTs
info.desc: Zoom through this fun, Gravity Modfier-packed course!
info.ultimatehint: You sure you need the first Gravity Modifier?
info.easteregghint: You'll definitely need the first Gravity Modifier. Fall off the ideal path once you do so.

info.ultimatehint: Go all the way to the other side first and then get to the last gem where the teleporter is.
info.easteregghint: Hidden in the left section of the level.
info.name: Slip Up - No Gems or TTs
info.desc: You'll have to control your mouse and keyboard in these varying friction challenges!

info.ultimatehint: Go fast, there're barely any shortcuts here
info.easteregghint: Stolen from Upward Spiral MBU.
info.starthelptext: Be careful!
info.name: Perilous Road - No Gems or TTs
info.desc: Follow the road to the top.

info.ultimatehint: You can hit with the gyrocopter and slant and then hit the next gem and the ring instead of going normally. Then, grab all the gems on the last part and bounce twice to the finish!
info.starthelptext: Be sure you have the right speed and height before going through the rings!
info.name: Ring Stunts - No Gems
info.desc: Jump or fly through the rings to get style points.

info.ultimatehint: Ask a Pathway Finder to help you here.
info.easteregghint: Touch the end pad to grab a secret Super Jump. Use it to reach the top of the level.
info.starthelptext: Be hasty!
info.name: Par Pit - No Gems
info.desc: Get to the finish pad before time runs out! You only have 3 minutes so use DIAGONAL MOVEMENT!

info.ultimatehint: Get on the platform and off the platform ASAP. If you manage the traplaunch and the route for sub-1 minute... wow!
info.easteregghint: Find a way to reach the top of the tower.
info.starthelptext: Do you feel the pressure?
info.name: Platform Race 2 - No Gems
info.desc: Get the [REDACTED] at each stop in 10 seconds or the platform shall leave you behind!

info.ultimatehint: The key is to jump...
info.easteregghint: Fall off one of the holes.
info.starthelptext: Just hang on, marble!
info.name: Quaked Path - No Gems
info.desc: Follow the path moving back and forth! The key is not to jump...

info.starthelptext: Ascend, frictionally.
info.name: Frictional Ascent - No Gems or TTs
info.desc: Ascend to the top while traversing the hazardous friction and collecting some cool powerups if you feel like it.
info.ultimatehint: Amazingly there is a shortcut, just find a method to save that Jump Boost.
info.easteregghint: Get plenty of height off the icy half pipe to reach a secret area.

info.name: Michael's Adventure: MBP! - No TTs
info.desc: Michael's Adventure strikes again!
info.ultimatehint: Disregard the marble's safety on tightropes.
info.easteregghint: One of the corners of the level behind the start. A nuke hit should do it.

info.starthelptext: Get to the finish without falling.
info.name: Treacherous Path - No Gems or TTs
info.desc: Can you make it past the treacherous hazards?
info.ultimatehint: Start the path normally, skip to the end and then do the level backwards.
info.easteregghint: Fall off a trapdoor.

info.starthelptext: Activate the powerups at the right time in order to pass the ordeals ahead!
info.name: Combo Course - No Gems or TTs
info.desc: Put your powerup skills to the ultimate test!
info.ultimatehint: Think well on how to use each powerup. Not all challenges need the two powerups available.
info.easteregghint: Fly to once of the holes behind where the fourth challenge is.

info.starthelptext: Make sure to maintain your balance on the treacherous branches!
info.name: Ultimate Tree - No Gems or TTs
info.desc: Explore this beautiful tree and collect cool bugs on the branches.
info.ultimatehint: Decide on a route which will collect everything. Most of the TTs will be useful.
info.easteregghint: Between the two elevators inside the trunk. Maybe a Gyrocopter should do it.

info.starthelptext: Keep in mind that you will need to conquer some of the techniques ahead.
info.name: Strategy Climb - No Gems or TTs
info.desc: Move your way to climb up the challenging path ahead!
info.ultimatehint: Jump early for the TT.
info.easteregghint: Behind the section where you change gravity.

info.ultimatehint: Trap your way to the finish, the intended way.
info.easteregghint: You'll need to do a traplaunch for this one.
info.starthelptext: When times get tough, don't lose hope!
info.name: Despair - No TTs
info.desc: Stay on the platform to pass the level!
An unforgettable moving platform challenge.
info.name: Morph - No Gems or TTs
info.starthelptext: Follow the arrows and watch this level morph before your eyes.
info.ultimatehint: The only thing here to rely on is speed.
info.easteregghint: This is a fun one. When you reach the finish, you'll activate the entrance to inside the castle, where the egg resides.

info.starthelptext: Beware; there are traps and obstacles galore in this castle!
info.name: Thief - No Gems or TTs
info.desc: Invade the castle and steal... nothing I guess.
info.ultimatehint: Ever hit a nuke with a gyrocopter? Try it, you get tons of height.
info.easteregghint: Nuke hit to one of the scenery castles.

info.starthelptext: Use the sloped edging to your advantage!
info.name: Rolling to Eternity - No Gems or TTs
info.desc: Collect all 0 gems by going through a variety of obstacles!
info.ultimatehint: Use the checkpoint and the super jump to your advantage.
info.easteregghint: Stolen from Daedalus MBU.

info.starthelptext: Can you handle the randomness?
info.name: Random Mayhem - No Gems or TTs
info.desc: Navigate your marble to its destinations while fighting off the hardest force of them all!
info.ultimatehint: Amazingly, at some points if you go at a certain direction, it will just help you go straightforwards in the direction you wanted. Use the sloped edges to stop your marble on each island. Ah, you did practice your spin, right?
info.easteregghint: Use a Super Speed to reach the top of the finish sign.

info.starthelptext: Roll and jump around but don't slip off the level!
info.name: Frictional Battlecube - No Gems or TTs
info.desc: Master a couple of friction surfaces!
info.ultimatehint: The old version of the level was way harder. After the ice melts, it becomes water.
info.easteregghint: Behind the sandy side. A Super Speed can help, but it might be tough.

info.desc: Welcome to the Intermediate Levels!
info.name: Triple Decker - No Gems
info.easteregghint: Need for the Super Speed.
info.ultimatehint: No need for the Super Speed.
info.starthelptext: Go under the 3 story building!

info.desc: Ascend up the path and head for the finish!
info.name: Mountaintop Retreat - No TTs
info.easteregghint: In the section where the Super Speed is, you can use it to reach a hole carved on one of the scenery pillars.
info.ultimatehint: Stolen from MBU.
info.starthelptext: Ascend up the path and head for the finish!

info.desc: Go through the castle's maze to find nothing of value.
info.name: Medieval Maze - No Gems

info.desc: Roll around the maze of ramps, finding the finish!

info.easteregghint: Gain as much speed as you can so you can hit the flower behind the start and gain enough height to reach to top of the arch.
info.ultimatehint: Slow down as you jump onto the flower, you'll find it much easier.

info.easteregghint: Wall hit off the icy stairs to reach it.
info.ultimatehint: You can escape the club!
info.desc: Pass the ice-covered challenges!
info.name: Marble Mini Golf: Icichole - No Gems or TTs
info.starthelptext: Aim carefully into the tunnel!
Don't slip off the level.
info.desc: A quick level to test your skills. Beware of the ice!
info.ultimatehint: Find a good path for the start and you're set.
info.name: Basic Agility Course - No Gems or TTs

info.starthelptext: Be careful on trim...
info.desc: Be careful around the tornado...
info.easteregghint: There is a Gyrocopter below the tornado. Use it to fling yourself up to the egg.
info.ultimatehint: Did you know I have sub-10? That's because I used the tornado and the trim.

info.starthelptext: Taking a stroll is not always easy...
info.desc: Move and jump carefully up and around the platforms, making sure you control your spin!
info.easteregghint: Jump off a sloped edging to reach it.
info.ultimatehint: You can still cross the gap!

info.desc: Lead the marble up the tricky trail but don't let the clock beat you!

info.starthelptext: Inspired by Level Seven.
info.desc: Roll quickly down the slopes before time runs out!

info.ultimatehint: Time your start and collect enough TTs.

info.desc: Roll around the inside of the rings because you're super cool and epic.
info.easteregghint: Below the gem under the rings. Change gravity or use a Super Speed.
info.ultimatehint: Either start with the loops, or go down, it is your choice.
info.name: Double LoopLoop - No Gems

info.starthelptext: Don't forget to collect the powerups!
info.desc: Practice your powerup skills!
info.easteregghint: The apex of the level.
info.ultimatehint: Use each powerup smartly.
info.name: Powerup Practice - No Gems

info.starthelptext: Do some sick air moves by bouncing off the walls!
info.desc: Master your finish-finding skills!
info.ultimatehint: I found it faster to make a sign hit, but its harder.
info.name: Wall Master - No Gems

info.starthelptext: Make your way past the trials ahead to finish!
info.desc: Control your spin so you can get to the finish!

info.ultimatehint: Skip from one side to another!
info.name: Spin Practice - No Gems or TTs

info.desc: A level meant for shortcuts, but you can beat it the long way too.

info.ultimatehint: You did train in loop exits, right?

info.starthelptext: Pick your shortcut!
info.desc: This level has so many shortcuts, it's not even funny!

info.ultimatehint: You'll need a lot of diagonal usage here...

info.desc: Just a small level to test your skills!

info.ultimatehint: There should be some points where you don't stop jumping.

info.easteregghint: Jump and double Super Jump high enough to reach it, but be careful, as you'll go out of bounds before getting it.
info.ultimatehint: Use the Super Jump to get to the next floor from the sides.

info.desc: Up the floors we go!

info.starthelptext: Evade the bumps, making sure you don't fall off!
info.ultimatehint: You can cross two gaps with ease if you use diagonal.

info.starthelptext:
The Gyrocopter can be used in many ways.
Learn the basics!

Collect the Time Travels and finish before the Par Time!

info.desc: Class is cancelled.

info.starthelptext: Use the Super Speeds to help you finish faster.
info.ultimatehint: There's more than one way to beat this Ultimate Time. Find a path you'll be happy with!

info.easteregghint: This is a tricky one. Make sure you have a Super Speed with you. Once you perform an edge hit at the center, use that Super Speed to propel yourself upwards where the egg is floating.

info.ultimatehint: Try not to use any powerups along your way... except for the last one.

info.starthelptext: Have fun!
info.ultimatehint: Blame Moshe for his pathway for an easy UT beater.

info.easteregghint: Find a secret area where the finish is.

info.starthelptext: Learn how to use diagonal movement!

info.easteregghint: There is a Gyrocopter on one of the pillars that you can use to reach the very end of the level.
info.desc: Learn how to use diagonal movement to make your marble go faster.

info.name: Luminascent
info.starthelptext: Platforms that need to be activated are a slightly darker shade of grey than the ones that move constantly.
info.trivia:
This started as a level to showcase a video tutorial on making moving platforms, until the brush count reached 2,900 and Constructor became too laggy. 

And yes, the "luminescent" typo is intentional.
info.ultimatehint: Optimize your efforts so you spend as little time as possible waiting for the next moving platform to come to you.

remarks: The simplicity of the level's design comes from the original intent of being the template for a moving platform tutorial video - also shown in the very linear movement of the platforms - but the curved edges and every single tile being a separate brush (for the rainbow effect) pretty quickly made Constructor start to lag. Over 2,900 brushes, which for my normal practices, seems pretty standard.

info.trivia:
This level was completely rebuilt after some foolish manipulations in order to fix my PQ's eternal crashing isssues, causing the loss of the older version of the level. 
Not neccesarily a bad thing, since I really took the time to improve the level's gameplay overall.
info.ultimatehint: At the beginning, ram fast enough into a bumper to propel yourself to the Time Travel on the roof, then cheese the first moving platform, Platform Training style!

info.awesomehint: Oh, so you haven't been told that this little platform giving you the access to the upper floor... could be reset?
info.desc: A luxuriant and dynamic garden filled with various interesting challenges, and it's yours to explore.
info.egghint: Every garden has its secret cave, it's a classic. Look for a red rock and get ready for some explodey concussions.
info.generalhint:
With the platforms, fading or moving, or with that dreadful rolling log, timing is going to be your best ally in most of the challenges. That aside, it's just your regular janitor level (I hate that term). 
For a first exploration, you should probably start by the right side.
info.name: Crystal Garden
info.starthelptext: Please remember that the water is non-drinkable.
info.trivia:
Gerson kind of challenged me to recreate his level from Great Marble Adventure, so, finding the idea very fun, I delivered. 
Not without trouble, though. Thanks, moving platforms and the last-minute egg placement.
info.ultimatehint: Time Travels? Yeah, the most valuable ones are, as usual, very well hidden.

info.awesomehint: Minimize your wall-hits for the third gem, and have a crumb of Gyrocopter left to make one big wall hit and snipe a Time Travel chilling above the pit.
info.desc: Look, it's no surprise that you have been using these techniques forever, but... let's revisit some of them once more, just for fun!
info.egghint: A Gyrocopter and a wall can offer you more than one way.
info.generalhint:
This level will revisit (or teach you) some of the most iconic powerup tricks in this game. 
Most of the time, you will want to get running starts, in order to have a wider range for your landing.
info.name: More Advanced Techniques
info.starthelptext: Beat the purple teleporter below!
info.trivia:
This level marks the beginning of my journey to be a better level maker than Threefolder. 
It took me way too much time to texture everything like he did in his predecessor level, but it was totally worth it in the end. 
Also, that drop is inspired from Trackmania Lagoon.
info.ultimatehint:
Use the first Super Jump a bit higher. The closer you are from the ceiling... the better. That will allow you to not care about an entire section! 
You can also take advantage of the sand bumps, ensuring you jump at the right moment.

info.awesomehint: Make it out of that keep-jumping section in 3 jumps.
info.desc: Solve this simple level, but watch out for the clock.
info.egghint: Among all of the yellow teleporters, one is an imposter. Reveal it by getting two gems, then look for an isolated platform...
info.generalhint: Teleporters are indicated by the ground flashing more or less rapidly, indicating their delay. While the orange teleporters are completely trustworthy, the yellow teleporters will send you to your doom!
info.name: Teleport-o-Presto
info.starthelptext: Go up there and pick an orange teleporter! Both choices are good!
info.trivia:
It's a remake of a Marble Blast Elite level, Requiem of Teleports. I don't know, I felt the need to remake this level. The idea just... popped into my mind, all of a sudden.
Originally, it was called Faster Teleporter Runner, until I found out how weird and generic this name sounded.
info.ultimatehint: As you're taking an orange teleporter, remember to have a little running start in the right direction before you're teleported, so you can carry some of that momentum after!

info.starthelptext: The SuperBounce has a special ability for the marble. It can make any surface bouncy for sometime.
info.name: Bounce On!
info.desc: Bounce for gems. Also grab the bonuses.

remarks: Comment below!

info.starthelptext: The Finish is close. Grab the gems. But don't get OOB.
info.name: Hazards Double Loop
info.desc: Grab the gems in this double square loops. But don't let these hazards throw you off.

remarks: Speedrun the level to get the best time.

info.desc: All interiors made with Torque Constructor!
info.easteregghint: Help the player find the Easter Egg! If you choose to place one, of course.

info.generalhint: Help the player beat your level!
info.name: Creeper's First Fully Custom Level!

If it does, then WAHOOO!!! :D my first successful custom custom level!!!
